jobs.title: PhD position in Organic Chemistry
jobs.employer: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
The Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen invites applicants for a PhD position in Organic Chemistry. The project is part of the research project “CO2 Capture using organic materials in aqueous systems”, which is financed by Novo Nordisk Foundation CO2 Research Center (CORC), and the research will take part in the group led by Associate Professor Jiwoong Lee.

Start dates are 01.12.2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The project
The project will study CO2 capture using non-conventional organic materials. Our objectives include design, synthesis and evaluation of organic materials that are scalable and applicable in aqueous systems. One strategy, for example, includes facile degradation and/or modification of waste plastic and the employment of bio-based sustainable sources of organic compounds in order to produce efficient absorbents and adsorbents for CO2. These molecules will be evaluated for CO2 capture and functionalization for further applications in biological and chemical CO2 conversion reactions.

Who are we looking for?
Applicants should hold an MSc degree in Chemistry with specialization in organic chemistry and/or organic synthesis. The candidate should be highly confident in written and spoken English. The candidates should be able to work independently and strive towards scientific excellence, be driven and self-motivated. The candidates should have excellent skills in organic synthesis with at least 2-3 years of laboratory experiences, and interested in working on mission-driven projects with “real world applications”. Experience in chemistry of CO2, CO2 capture, CO2 utilization, or polymer chemistry will be highly valued. As criteria for the assessment of your qualifications, emphasis will also be laid on previous publications (if any) and relevant work experience with GPC, NMR, solid state NMR, TGA, DSC, and gas sorption. The candidate is expected to participate and present in group meetings and seminars and generally be a contributing member of the research group, cooperating within and across projects, and participating in lab activities and outreach programs. There is also the expectation of presenting the project often at local, national and international meetings and conferences. As a PhD student at the department of chemistry, teaching duties apply.

Our group and research- and what do we offer?
The group is located at the Department of Chemistry, Organic Chemistry section, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. The group is also part of the The Novo Nordisk Foundation CO2 Research Center (CORC), the Center for Medicinal Chemistry and the Nanoscience Center. We are a dynamic and international research group of about 15-20 members situated in Copenhagen. Our students and staff members come from different academic backgrounds, and have in common a deep curiosity and eagerness to do research in organic chemistry, methodology, organic synthesis that has real-world applications. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions. Postdocs will gain skills in diverse fields of chemical science, including organic, inorganic and organometallic chemistry, polymer chemistry, materials science and catalysis.

Principal supervisor is Associate Professor Jiwoong Lee, Department of Chemistry, jiwoong.lee@chem.ku.dk, Direct Phone: 35333312.

The PhD programme
A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree. Candidates without such qualifications will not be considered.

Qualifications needed for the programme
To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Organic Chemistry. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

Terms of employment in the regular programme
Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

Responsibilities and tasks in the PhD programme

  • Carry through an independent research project under supervision
  • Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE
  • Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad in collaborative programs
  • Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities
  • Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project
We are looking for the following qualifications:

  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevant publications
  • Relevant work experience
  • Other relevant professional activities
  • Curious mind-set with a strong interest in organic chemistry and peptides
  • Good language skills
Application and Assessment Procedure
Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically in UCPH Job Portal.

Please include:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page), stating which PhD project you are applying for
  2. Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. Original diplomas for Bachelor of Science or Master of Science and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted.
  4. Publication list (if available)
  5. Reference letters (if available)
Application deadline:

The deadline for applications is 16 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST).

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held during weeks 38-39 of 2026.

Questions
For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor (Associate Professor Jiwoong Lee, Department of Chemistry, jiwoong.lee@chem.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +4535333312).

General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website.



The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Pastry chef for winter season 2026-2027
jobs.description:
Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad. We are looking for a skilled and experienced pastry chef to join us for our winter season 2026-2027.

Job Description:

We are seeking for highly skilled and experienced Indian curry & tandoori Chefs to join our team at India Tandoori, a premium establishment specializing in authentic Indian cuisine. The ideal candidates will have extensive experience working with Tandoori and traditional Indian cooking methods, especially North Indian, South Indian, and Awadhi cuisines.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and cook a variety of dishes, with a focus on Tandoori and traditional Indian flavors.

  • Maintain high standards of hygiene and kitchen safety.

  • Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency meet the restaurant's high standards.

  • Collaborate with the kitchen team to innovate and improve the menu.

  • Oversee the kitchen operations during service and ensure smooth workflow.

Requirements:

  • Completed education or degree from a recognized university or college, such as a 3-year Hotel Management degree.

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional education and/or work experience in Indian cuisine, particularly in Tandoori cooking and related culinary techniques.

  • Experience in preparing North Indian, South Indian, and Awadhi cuisine.

  • At least half of your practical experience must have been gained working in a restaurant or hotel of a high standard.

  • Strong knowledge of traditional Indian cooking techniques and spices, especially in Tandoori cooking.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure kitchen environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Previous experience working in international or upscale restaurants is an advantage.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with a diverse team.

Application Process: Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and educational background. We look forward to hearing how your skills and expertise can contribute to the continued success of our restaurant.

Our Restaurant India Tandoori is Norway's oldest Indian restaurant, established in 1991. Our goal is to ensure that each guest leaves feeling satisfied, happy, and eager to return. We take great pride in making sure our visitors are not only well-fed but also enjoy an exceptional experience that brings them back for more.

We are now seeking a skilled Indian chef to join our team at our location in Bryne, Norway.

På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

R&D Unit Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

Are you interested in shaping the next generation of high-quality, scalable and easy configurable softstarters within ABB’s Electrification business area? Would you like to apply your expertise in a challenging and fascinating environment in a global and diverse company?

Then, join our team of highly motivated engineers as a R&D engineer for electronics hardware development, and contribute to the foundations of next-generation ABB products. You will maintain our active product portfolio, contribute creative ideas to product realization initiatives and propose innovative development projects addressing customer specific requirements. We provide an agile, dynamic workplace and you will be part of a cross-functional agile team embedded in a global network of collaborating teams.

We expect that you show a high motivation, hands-on attitude as well as taking initiative to come up with new ideas that tackle today’s challenges.

    You design, develop, and implement analog and digital circuits from concept phase to serial production.
    Your tasks include creation of schematics and definition of constraints for PCB layout, definition of verification specifications and execution of verification activities of your designs by simulation and prototype testing, as well as documentation and handover of the developed technologies with subsequent implementation support to production engineering.
    You collaborate closely with product owner, product management, system architects and software developers to breakdown market requirements to product requirements for hardware.
    You monitor technology developments and product technologies to identify technical drivers for R&D projects, supported by your thorough understanding of key business drivers for ABB’s products and solutions.
    You participate in internal and external networks to expand your knowledge of your area of expertise.
    You take responsibility for hardware development activities, as (senior) member, including risk identification, alignment with targets, and close coordination with suppliers and other functions (e.g. product management).
    You contribute to discussions of intellectual property and secure patent rights for ABB by driving the IP creation.

Qualifications for the role

    M.Sc. or B.Sc degree in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems or comparable field
    At least 5 years of experience in development of electronics within embedded systems as a hardware design engineer in an industrial context
    Sound knowledge in designing electronic circuits, circuit diagrams, and working with simulation tools
    Experience in testing and validation of prototypes in a laboratory. Proven experience in working with voltage levels up to ~1kV would be considered a plus
    Knowledge in EMC compatible design would be considered a plus
    Willingness to travel internationally (<5%)
    Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential; Swedish language skills are beneficial but not a prerequisite.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own our vulnerability management program end to end. In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.



What you'll do:

 - Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.

 - Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.

 - Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.

 - Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.

 - SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.

 - Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.

 - Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.

 - Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.

 - Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.

 - Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.



Required Skill & Experience:

 - Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.

 - Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.

 - Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.

 - Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).

 - Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.

 - Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.

 - Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.

 - Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.



What we value:

 - Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.

 - Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.
   
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: "Bricklayer wanted for Ærø - work with an ocean view"
jobs.description:
An Ærø-based construction firm seeks one to two qualified bricklayers for a team of 12-14 employees focusing on diverse projects, including restorations and new builds. The role offers high autonomy, varied work, and the opportunity to live in a scenic coastal community.   To help you proceed, would you like me to translate specific terms, help you draft an application in German, or find information about living on Ærø?      

Hier bietet sich eine seltene Gelegenheit für ein Arbeitsleben, in dem Fachlichkeit, Freiheit und Lebensqualität Hand in Hand gehen.

Auf Ærø bauen wir nicht nur Häuser. Wir erhalten und restaurieren einige der schönsten historischen Gebäude Dänemarks, renovieren ältere Immobilien und errichten Neubauten für Einheimische und Zugezogene. Deshalb sind die Aufgaben vielseitig, und kein Arbeitstag ist wie der andere.

Zugleich wirst du Teil einer Inselgemeinschaft, in der die Natur direkt vor der Tür liegt, die Wege kurz sind und viele erleben, dass mehr Zeit für Familie, Freizeit und das gute Leben bleibt.

Wir suchen derzeit ein bis zwei Maurergesellen, die Teil unseres Teams auf Ærø werden möchten.

Über die Stelle

Wir führen alle Arten von Arbeiten aus:

  • Neubau

  • Renovierung

  • Restaurierungsarbeiten

  • Umbau und Instandhaltung

Viele unserer Projekte finden an den charakteristischen älteren Gebäuden und erhaltenswerten Immobilien Ærøs statt. Das sorgt für eine spannende und abwechslungsreiche handwerkliche Arbeit.

Wir sind 12-14 Mitarbeitende und haben häufig auch 2 Maurerlehrlinge.

Du bekommst im Alltag viel Freiheit, arbeitest selbstständig und hast die Möglichkeit, die Planung deiner eigenen Aufgaben mitzugestalten.

Über dich

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du:

  • ausgebildeter Maurergeselle bist

  • Lust auf eine vielseitige Arbeit hast

  • selbstständig arbeiten kannst

  • qualitätsbewusst und verantwortungsvoll bist

  • einen Führerschein hast (Klasse B)

Am wichtigsten ist jedoch, dass du Lust hast, Teil eines kleineren Teams zu sein, in dem wir einander helfen und einen unkomplizierten Umgangston pflegen.

Warum Ærø wählen?

Ærø ist Heimat von knapp 6.000 Einwohnerinnen und Einwohnern und bietet einige der schönsten Küstenlandschaften Dänemarks.

Hier findest du:

  • Meer, Strand und Natur direkt vor der Tür

  • gute Möglichkeiten zum Segeln, Angeln, Radfahren, Wandern, Golfspielen und vieles mehr

  • ein aktives Vereins- und Kulturleben

  • Schulen, Kindertagesstätten, Ärztehaus und gute Alltagseinrichtungen

  • eine starke lokale Gemeinschaft

Mehr Arbeit fühlt sich wie Freizeit an, und mehr Freizeit wie Urlaub. Nicht weil wir auf Ærø weniger arbeiten, sondern weil sich das Leben rund um die Arbeit anders anfühlt.

Wir helfen dir, gut anzukommen

Wir wissen, dass es eine große Entscheidung sein kann, auf eine Insel zu ziehen.

Deshalb bieten wir unter anderem:

  • Hilfe bei der Wohnungssuche

  • bezahlte Fährtickets

  • Firmenwagen

  • Möglichkeit einer 4-Tage-Woche

  • große Flexibilität bei der Planung der Arbeitszeit

Die Stelle kann auch für dich interessant sein, wenn du zur Insel pendeln möchtest.

Möchtest du mehr erfahren?

Ruf Maurermeister Per Elman unter der Telefonnummer +45 20 21 50 71 an - für ein unverbindliches Gespräch über die Stelle und die Möglichkeiten auf Ærø.

Es gibt 2 freie Stellen.

jobs.title: ICEYE : Senior Payroll Specialist (Fixed-term Contract)
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, fixed term (3-6 months)

Location:Maarintie 6, 02150 Espoo, hybrid

Application deadline: 10.08.2026

ICEYE is looking for a **Senior Payroll Specialist** to join the Global Payroll team as an additional resource during an exciting period of growth.

This is a fixed-term position for approximately 3–6 months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible. We review applications throughout the application period and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will support global payroll operations across ICEYE's international organization, with a particular focus on Finland, one of the company's largest payroll entities. Working closely with the Senior Payroll Specialist based in Warsaw, as well as colleagues in HR and Finance and external payroll providers, you will help ensure accurate and compliant payroll operations while contributing to the continuous development of payroll processes.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating end-to-end payroll operations across approximately 12 countries together with external payroll providers

- Preparing, validating, and submitting payroll data to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing

- Ensuring payroll activities comply with local legislation and internal policies

- Supporting the onboarding of new legal entities and contributing to process development and automation initiatives

- Partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to continuously improve payroll operations


**What makes you a great fit?**

We hope you are a proactive and detail-oriented payroll professional who enjoys solving problems and improving ways of working. You thrive in a fast-paced international environment, communicate effectively with stakeholders across functions, and take ownership of delivering high-quality payroll services.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 3–5 years of experience in end-to-end payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment

- Strong knowledge of Finnish payroll legislation and payroll processes, with experience supporting payroll across Europe

- Experience working with third-party payroll providers in a multinational environment

- Excellent Excel skills and experience working with payroll and HRIS systems

- A full working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Knowledge of local labor and payroll legislation outside Europe


**We can offer you:**

- A unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing New Space company operating globally

- Meaningful ownership in an international payroll environment supporting employees across multiple countries

- The opportunity to improve payroll processes and help shape future ways of working

- A collaborative and experienced team where your expertise is valued from day one

- Cozy office spaces in Otaniemi, Espoo


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and 3-6 months fixed term position. You will be employed as aTalent employee at ICEYE. We hope you can start as soon as possible. The role will be located in Espoo, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 5200-5500 €/month (gross) depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Sounds like you?** Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 10th of August via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/373689/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with ICEYE here: https://www.iceye.com/company. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Junior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen(+358 503613288, sofia.hyvarinen\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Project Specialist, Konecranes
jobs.description:
**_Konecranes moves what matters._** _We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination._

**Would you be our new Project Specialist?**

We are looking for a Project Specialist to join Konecranes and play a key role in customer invoicing and project support activities related to crane delivery projects. In this role, you will be responsible for both external and internal customer invoicing in Finland while also supporting invoicing-related activities across the Nordic countries. You will work closely with project managers and sales teams, ensuring that invoicing, project administration and project closing activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

Your day-to-day work will focus primarily on invoicing-related tasks, including handling bank and corporate guarantees as well as credit note processes. You will support project and order closing activities in SAP and help ensure that invoicing and project processes run smoothly throughout the entire project lifecycle. In addition, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of processes and ways of working, and when needed, support project managers with various administrative tasks.

The position is a full-time fixed-term assignment for 12 months, with a possibility for continuation. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. We hope you can start as soon as possible, preferably during September 2026. The role is based in Hämeenlinna and offers a hybrid working model after the onboarding period.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a professional with an interest in invoicing, project support and business processes. To succeed in this role, we hope you have previous experience in invoicing-related tasks and ideally a commercial, business, or finance-related educational background. Experience with SAP is considered a strong advantage, particularly if you have worked with invoicing or order-related processes. You communicate fluently in Finnish and have a good command of English, as you will collaborate with stakeholders in Finland and across the Nordic countries.

As a person, you are proactive, systematic and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and can work independently while also collaborating effectively with stakeholders. Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to solve problems are important in this role, as you will need to identify and resolve invoicing-related issues and help ensure that processes run smoothly. We also value a development-oriented mindset and an interest in improving ways of working and creating more efficient processes.

**Why join Konecranes?**

Konecranes offers you an opportunity to work in a global technology company whose solutions help keep ports and industries moving around the world. You will join an experienced and supportive team where expertise is actively shared and learning is encouraged. Through this role, you will gain broad exposure to delivery projects, project business, and SAP-based processes, giving you a comprehensive understanding of how customer projects progress from order creation all the way to final delivery and invoicing.

As your expertise grows, you will have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and explore different career paths within Konecranes. The experience gained in this role can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities in project management, project support, and specialist positions. In addition, this role supports a long-term business need, meaning there is a possibility to continue your career with Konecranes after the initial assignment period.

**Are you interested?**

If you are interested, we would love to hear from you as soon as possible. Please submit your application via the link by 20.8.2026. Interviews will be started already during the application period, and the position will be filled once the right person is found.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, email: **elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi**.

jobs.title: Architecte réseaux laser en espace libre (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job posting in English below

Rejoignez Airbus Defence & Space !

Au sein d'Airbus Defence and Space, le rôle de l'entité Connected Intelligence (CI) est de fournir à ses clients des solutions de communications sécurisées, à haut débit, multimédia (voix, données, vidéo), disponibles à tout moment et partout dans le monde.

Pour ce faire, CI est devenu un leader mondial des communications par satellites (SATCOM) civiles et militaires capable de concevoir et opérer des infrastructures en propre ou pour ses clients. Pour maintenir ce leadership, CI mène une politique ambitieuse d'innovation afin d'étoffer son portefeuille de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée.

Dans ce but, CI cherche un/une Architecte réseaux Laser en espace libre (H/F) maîtrisant les technologies de communication par Laser et la réalisation de réseaux incluant des segments Laser :
Réseau IP conventionnels;
Réseaux point à point, point à multipoint, maillés, ... ;
Porteurs fixes et mobiles;
Milieux : spatial, aérien, terrestre, maritime.


Vous avez un intérêt pour les réseaux IP et les systèmes de communication complexes, hautement sécurisés. Vous êtes capable de faire preuve de créativité et avez l'envie de vous investir sur des sujets techniques complexes et innovants. Vous serez intégré(e) à un pôle d'ingénierie chargé de concevoir et développer les systèmes de communication de défense du futur.  

Les activités actuelles de l'équipe ont pour but d'exploiter les possibilités offertes par les technologies émergentes (laser, quantique,...) dans le cadre des services de communications sécurisés, sur tout type de support (satellite, 5G,...), en utilisant des techniques de réseaux programmables (SDN).

Vous prendrez part en tant qu'Architecte aux différents projets faisant appel aux moyens de communication Laser.

Ce poste exige une connaissance des risques potentiels de non-conformité.

Le/la titulaire s'engage à agir avec intégrité, fondement du succès et de la croissance durable de la Société.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous aurez les missions suivantes :
Assurer une veille technologique permanente au contact des équipes internes et des équipementiers ;
Supporter les avant ventes à savoir (ex : pédagogie envers les équipes internes et envers les clients; proposition de solutions techniques) ;
Maquetter des solutions ou des preuves de concept ;
Contribuer à la conception des solutions destinées aux clients (ex: spécification des segments Laser; Interface avec les autres composants systèmes) ;
Spécifier les évolutions nécessaires des composant Airbus Defence & Space pour implémenter ces solutions et identifier d'éventuels nouveaux composants à développer ;
Assurer le maintien de tous les documents techniques liés aux solutions proposées ;
Support et expertise aux équipes de conception et d'IVQ système.


Profil :

Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
Titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine des réseaux informatiques avec une spécialisation sur les systèmes optiques Laser et Optoélectronique ;
Expérience dans des environnements réseaux complexes, typés opérateurs télécom ou militaire ou WAN étendus de grands groupes ou d'OIV ;
Capacité reconnue à concevoir et réaliser des solutions techniques livrées à des clients ;
Connaissance des problématiques de transmission par laser ainsi que des réseaux IP classiques ;
Notions d'ingénierie des systèmes complexes ;
Vous êtes autonome et désireux de porter des sujets innovants ;
Vous savez travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires et avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles ;
Niveau de négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.


====

Join Airbus Defence & Space !

Within Airbus Defence and Space CIS, the role of the Connected Intelligence (CI) business unit is to provide its customers with secure, high-speed, multimedia (voice, data, video) communications solutions available at any time and anywhere in the world.

To achieve this, CI has become a world leader in civil and military satellite communications (SATCOM), capable of designing and operating infrastructure on its own or for its customers. To maintain this leadership, CI is pursuing an ambitious policy of innovation to expand its portfolio of high value-added solutions.

To this end, CI is looking for a Free Space Laser Network Architect (M/F) who is proficient in laser communication technologies and the implementation of networks including laser segments:
Conventional IP network;
Point to point, point to multipoint, mesh networks, ... ;
Fixed and mobile carriers;
Environments: space, air, land, sea.


You have an interest in IP networks and complex, highly secure communication systems.

jobs.title: Docent til Center for Socialt Arbejde
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle ny viden om socialt arbejde med voksne mennesker i udsatte og komplekse livssituationer? Har du en stærk forskningsprofil og ambitioner om at styrke samspillet mellem forskning, uddannelse og praksis? Så er du måske vores nye docent i Center for Socialt Arbejde på Professionshøjskolen Absalon.

Center for Socialt Arbejde udvikler praksisnær forskning i tæt samarbejde med socialrådgiverprofessionen, kommuner, civilsamfundsorganisationer og andre aktører på det sociale område. Forskningen bidrager til udviklingen af socialfaglig praksis og understøtter grunduddannelse samt efter- og videreuddannelse inden for socialt arbejde.

Stillingen er forankret i forskningsmiljøet 'Psykiatri, handicap og psykisk mistrivsel på det sociale område', som arbejder med aktuelle samfunds- og praksisudfordringer på handicap, psykiatri- og udsathedsområdet. Læs mere om forskningsmiljøet her https://phabsalon.dk/forskning/forskningsmiljoeer/psykiatri-handicap-og-psykisk-mistrivsel-paa-det-sociale-omraade

I forskningsmiljøet ønsker vi at styrke forskningen i socialt arbejde med voksne mennesker i udsatte og komplekse livssituationer. Vi er særligt interesserede i forskning, der belyser, hvordan handicap, psykisk mistrivsel, psykiatriske diagnoser, fattigdom, vold og andre former for social udsathed påvirker menneskers muligheder for deltagelse, trivsel og et selvstændigt hverdagsliv.

Vi ønsker at udvikle ny viden om, hvordan socialfaglige indsatser, tværsektorielt samarbejde og relationelle tilgange kan understøtte mennesker med komplekse støttebehov. Forskningen skal bidrage til at styrke socialfaglig praksis og skabe løsninger på aktuelle samfunds- og praksisudfordringer inden for handicap-, psykiatri- og udsathedsområdet.

Din profil
Du motiveres af at skabe sammenhæng mellem forskning, uddannelse og praksis og ser det som en central opgave at bidrage til udviklingen af socialrådgiveruddannelsen og efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Du har en ph.d.-grad og dokumenteret erfaring med forskning, forskningsledelse og udvikling af forskningsmiljøer fra en forsknings- eller vidensproducerende organisation. Herudover kan du se dig selv i følgende:

Etableret dig som forsker inden for socialt arbejde med voksne mennesker i udsatte og komplekse livssituationer. Din forskning beskæftiger sig eksempelvis med samspillet mellem handicap, psykisk mistrivsel, fattigdom, vold, traumatiske livserfaringer eller andre forhold, som former menneskers livsbetingelser og muligheder for deltagelse i samfundet.

Dokumenteret erfaring med at publicere i nationale og internationale tidsskrifter og kan omsætte forskningsbaseret viden til praksis, uddannelse og faglig udvikling.

Indgående kendskab til socialfaglig praksis og erfaring med forskning, der udvikles i tæt samspil med borgere, professionelle og organisationer på det sociale område. Erfaring med forskning i sociale indsatser for mennesker med komplekse støttebehov vil være en fordel.

Dokumenteret erfaring med forskningsfaglig ledelse og udvikling af forskningsmiljøer. Du kan skabe faglig retning, understøtte kollegers forskningsudvikling og bidrage til opbygning af bæredygtige forskningsfællesskaber. Du har erfaring med at koordinere forskningsaktiviteter, understøtte publiceringsstrategier og skabe sammenhæng mellem forskningsprojekter og forskningsmiljøets samlede udvikling.

Erfaring med at udvikle større forskningsprojekter, etablere nationale og internationale samarbejder samt hjemtage ekstern finansiering. Derudover har du erfaring med at understøtte kollegers forskningsudvikling gennem faglig sparring, vejledning og forskningsledelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Med denne stilling er der tilknyttet to docenter til forskningsmiljøet. Du indgår, sammen med den eksisterende docent, i den faglige ledelse af forskningsmiljøet og har et medansvar for forskningsledelse, forskningsstrategisk udvikling og kapacitetsopbygning. I docentteamet har I ansvar for den faglige koordinering og udvikling af forskningsmiljøet, for sammenhængen mellem forskning, uddannelse og praksis, samt for at understøtte medarbejdernes udvikling af forskningsprofiler og forskningskompetencer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte at:

Udvikle, lede og gennemføre praksisnære forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter inden for socialt arbejde. Du tager et strategisk ansvar for udvikling af større forskningsansøgninger, hjemtager ekstern finansiering og udvikler langsigtede finansieringsstrategier for forskningsmiljøet. Samtidig bidrager du til den forskningsfaglige udvikling af centret gennem sparring, vejledning og understøttelse af kollegers forskningsaktiviteter.

Publicerer forskning i nationale og internationale videnskabelige tidsskrifter samt formidle forskningsresultater til praksis, uddannelse og offentlighed.

Styrke og udvikle samarbejder med kommuner, civilsamfundsorganisationer, videninstitutioner og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. Herudover skal du bidrage til udviklingen af nationale og internationale forskningsnetværk inden for dit forskningsfelt.

Bidrage til opbygning af forskningskapacitet gennem vejledning, mentoring og understøttelse af medarbejderes forsknings- og publiceringsaktiviteter, herunder udvikling af forskningsprofiler, ph.d.-ansøgninger og forskningssamarbejder. Du skal også bidrage til udvikling og kvalificering af ph.d.-projekter, samt vejlede og understøtte forskningsaktive medarbejdere i udviklingen af forskningskarrierer.

Bidrage til den strategiske prioritering af forskningsressourcer og medvirke til planlægning, opfølgning og udvikling af forskningsmiljøets samlede projektportefølje og eksterne finansiering.

Dine kolleger
Center for Socialt Arbejde er fordelt på tre lokationer i henholdsvis Roskilde, Slagelse og Nykøbing F. Du bliver en del af Absalons samlede forskningsorganisation med adgang til tværgående docentnetværk, forskningsfaglige samarbejder på tværs af centre, samt støtte fra Stab for Forskning og Udvikling. Forskningsmiljøerne samarbejder tæt om udvikling af forskningsprojekter, forskningsansøgninger, publicering og forskningsstrategiske indsatser.

Vi er ca. 58 medarbejdere og har ansvar for grunduddannelsen for socialrådgivere, samt efter- og videreuddannelse inden for dette fagområde. Herudover har vi også forskning og udvikling. Forskningsmiljøet består af 11 forskningsaktive medarbejdere, herunder den nuværende docent, vores nye docentkollega der ansættes i denne stilling, samt en kernebemanding på ni forskere og undervisere med forskningsopgaver.

Du får arbejdssted i Roskilde, Slagelse eller Nykøbing F., og får direkte reference til centerchef og uddannelsesleder, der har det tværgående ansvar for forskningsindsatsen i centret. Du skal påregne aktiviteter i tilknytning til alle vores udbudssteder dækkende hele Region Sjælland, hvorfor der vil være tjenstlig kørsel til de øvrige campusser i arbejdstiden.

I det daglige samarbejder du med de forskningsaktive medarbejdere på alle tre lokationer, samt vores tre uddannelsesledere i centret.

Du bliver en del af et visionært center med et godt arbejdsmiljø, engagerede medarbejdere og et stærkt netværk til praksis. Vi ser et stort potentiale for at udvikle forskningsbaseret viden, der bidrager til både den faglige udvikling af socialt arbejde og løsningen af aktuelle samfundsudfordringer.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og relevant faglig organisation, samt i henhold til bekendtgørelse om stillingsstruktur og bekendtgørelse om bl.a. docentbedømmelse. Se link længere nede.
  • Lønniveauet for stillingen er 64.114 kr./md. inkl. pension. Hertil er der mulighed for at forhandle kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og ansættelse sker for en tidsbegrænset periode på 6 år. Der kan være mulighed for forlængelse efter docenturets ophør.
  • Vi vil gerne have, at du begynder den 1. oktober eller 1. november 2026.
  • Dine kvalifikationer bliver vurderet af et internt ansættelsesudvalg og et eksternt bedømmelsesudvalg. Bedømmelsen sker udelukkende ud fra det fremsendte materiale.
  • Ud over ansøgning og CV skal du fremsende:
    • Uddannelsesbeviser
    • Publikationsliste med angivelse af peer-reviewede publikationer.
    • 3 udvalgte publikationer, som ønskes inddraget i bedømmelsen. De udvalgte publikationer skal fremgå tydeligt af publikationslisten og må gerne ledsages af en kort begrundelse for deres relevans i forhold til stillingen. Bedømmelsesudvalget vil lægge vægt på disse publikationer i vurderingen af ansøgerens forskningsprofil og videnskabelige kvalifikationer.
    • Eventuelle medforfattererklæringer, hvis publikationerne er skrevet sammen med andre forfattere.
    • En forskningsplan på maksimalt 3 sider (se link længere nede).
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest 16. august 2026. https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger
  • Ansættelsesudvalget præselekterer i de modtagne kandidater ud fra ansøgeres kvalifikationer holdt op imod stillingen. Hvis du bliver udvalgt til bedømmelse, bliver dine kvalifikationer vurderet af et eksternt bedømmelsesudvalg. Bedømmelsen sker udelukkende ud fra det fremsendte materiale.
  • Ansættelsesprocessen forventes at tage ca. 3 måneder efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte centerchef Anne Rovsing anro@pha.dk, tlf. 7248 2222 eller docent og forskningsfagligleder Cecilie K. Moesby-Jensen ckmj@pha.dk tlf. 7248 1840.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. ansættelsessamtale i uge 41 den 2. ansættelsessamtale i uge 44

Der henvises i øvrigt til følgende bekendtgørelser, bedømmelseskriterier og interne retningslinjer:
Bekendtgørelse nr. 414 af 27. april 2025 om stillingsstruktur for undervisere ved erhvervsakademier, professionshøjskoler m.v. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/414

Bekendtgørelse nr. 413 af 27. april 2025 om lektorkvalificering, lektorbedømmelse og docentbedømmelse af undervisere ved erhvervsakademier, professionshøjskoler m.v. Bilag 2, Kriterier for docentbedømmelse, jf. § 19 https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/413

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Adjunkter eller lektorer til Center for Pædagogik
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at give vores studerende og kursister nogle stærke faglige forudsætninger for at arbejde professionelt og i praksis med det pædagogiske fagområde.

Center for Pædagogik i Roskilde søger to adjunkter eller lektorer til faste stillinger med henblik på at planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisning på pædagoguddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Vi søger to undervisere, som tilsammen kan styrke centerets kompetencer inden for musik, e-læring, social- og specialpædagogik samt specialpædagogisk støtte (SPS). Det forventes ikke at du har kompetencer inden for alle områder.

På professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition at levere engagerende undervisning. Det er en del af vores uddannelsesløfte til de studerende, at du skal facilitere undervisning af høj kvalitet og samtidig brænde for at skabe læring og motivere de studerende. Det er vigtigt, at de studerende kan mærke deres uddannelse fra første dag. Det bidrager til en særlig uddannelseskultur, hvor du som underviser understøtter et fællesskab mellem de studerende, der bidrager til en samlet organisation, sætter de studerende først og har en stærk uddannelsesprofessionalisme.

Din profil
Du får en vigtig funktion i forhold til at undervise både på grunduddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Det er derfor væsentligt, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Særlige faglige kompetencer. Du har erfaringer og viden inden for ét eller flere af følgende områder: musik, e-læring, social- og specialpædagogik eller specialpædagogisk støtte (SPS) til studerende. Vi søger forskellige faglige profiler og forventer derfor ikke, at du dækker alle områder. Du formår at omsætte teoretisk viden til praksis, samt har flair for at inddrage de studerendes egne erfaringer som en naturlig del af undervisningen. Der lægges vægt på forståelse for læringsmiljøer, udviklingsprocesser og inkluderende klasseledelse, samt evnen til at formidle stoffet engageret og praksisnært til en mangfoldig målgruppe.

Praksiserfaring. Du har erfaring med at arbejde i pædagogiske praksisfelter. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring inden for ét eller flere af følgende områder: social- og specialpædagogik, musik og musiske læreprocesser, e-læring eller SPS til studerende.

Didaktisk erfaring og kompetencer. Du står stærkt i mødet med studerende, hvor din undervisning bærer præg af variation, nærvær og engagement. Du kan facilitere og lede læreprocesser, og din undervisning bærer præg af at være varieret, nærværende og engageret. Din tilgang til undervisningen skal være kendetegnet ved en ambition om inddragelse samt et højt fagligt niveau med øje for at skabe forskellige deltagelsesmuligheder for de studerende.

Stærke samarbejdsevner. Du er interesseret i at være en del af et læringsfællesskab, hvor undervisningen udvikles sammen med dine kolleger, og hvor faglig sparring er en fast bestanddel af hverdagen.

Fokus på kerneopgaven og gode studiemiljøer. Du har en høj faglighed, og du ser kerneopgaven som omdrejningspunktet for prioriteringen af dine arbejdsopgaver. Du kan derudover se dig selv bidrage til Absalons uddannelsesløfte. Dette indebærer blandt andet skabelsen af inkluderende studiemiljøer.

Derudover forventer vi os, at:
  • du har en master-, kandidatuddannelse eller ph.d. relateret til det pædagogiske fagområde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser i Center for Pædagogik vil dit arbejde foregå inden for tre områder:

Grunduddannelsen. Du indgår i et team, der tilrettelægger og evaluerer undervisningen og samarbejder om at udvikle kvaliteten i de moduler, du skal undervise på. Du kommer også til at arbejde på tværs af teams i forbindelse med overleveringer mellem moduler.

Efter- og videreuddannelsen. Du bliver en del af forskellige samarbejdskonstellationer omkring planlægning og gennemførelse af efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Du skal forvente at undervise flere forskellige steder i og uden for regionen og på vores andre lokationer. Det er derfor en fordel, at du har egen bil.

Forskning og udvikling. Du skal forvente at deltage i praksisnære og innovative forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter.

Du må forvente, at der i begrænset omfang kan forekomme undervisning til kl. 18.00 og om lørdagen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Center for Pædagogik med omkring 140 medarbejdere fordelt pa? fem af Absalons campusser. Din primære arbejdsplads vil være i Roskilde.

Pa? pædagoguddannelsen i Roskilde er vi en dynamisk arbejdsplads med ca. 50 dygtige medarbejdere. Hver eneste dag arbejder vi sammen om at uddanne fremtidens pædagoger og gøre nuværende fagprofessionelle og ledere dygtigere.

Campus Roskilde ligger i gåafstand fra Trekroner Station.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.994, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.938 kr. inkl. pension.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. oktober 2026.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Jacob Guldager Søe på tlf. 7248 1482 eller uddannelsesleder Thue Friislund på tlf. 72 48 1486. Pga. ferie kan de først kontaktes fra den 3. august 2026.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest torsdag den 13. august
  • Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 34 og 35.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer vil du blive ansat som adjunkt eller lektor
På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5.

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
jobs.description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Nanny Camp Hill
jobs.description:
Full-time Nanny, Camp Hill (40-hours), Commence ASAP!

Hours: MondayâFriday, approx. 40hrs per week (6amâ2pm) | Permanent Full-Time (4-day week may be considered for the right candidate)

Salary: From $70,000 + super + entitlements

Minis: Two boys, 4 & 2, with a baby girl due in November

Commence: ASAP

About Our Clients

This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. Dad is a busy business owner, while Mum is a stay-at-home mum preparing to welcome their third mini later this year. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.

Their boys are active, curious and full of laughter, enjoying swimming lessons, music, park adventures and playing with monster trucks. The family embraces a healthy lifestyle with limited screen time and loves outdoor play and learning through everyday experiences.

Duties

  • Sole charge of the minis when required
  • Planning fun, engaging outings and activities
  • Taking the minis to swimming, music and other social activities
  • Preparing healthy meals for the minis
  • Light household duties including kitchen tidying, dishes, rubbish and general wipe-downs
  • Driving the minis to activities using the family vehicle
  • Supporting the smooth running of the household during busy mornings


The perfect fit

You're reliable, adaptable and personable, with a genuine passion for supporting young families. You are known to be a nanny who is respectful and not overbearing and follows family routine whilst being confident working independently while respecting the family's routines and parenting style.

All you need is minimum 3-yrs professional childcare and or nanny experience, a valid Blue Card, police check, first aid/CPR certification and a current driver's licence. Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds trust naturally, communicates openly and enjoys creating a calm, fun and nurturing environment where children can thrive.

What's in it for you?

  • Become a genuinely valued and trusted member of a warm family
  • A supportive, respectful workplace where you'll be appreciated
  • Long-term, permanent employment providing stability and consistency
  • A nanny car for your job
  • Competitive salary plus superannuation and full entitlements
  • Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with three wonderful children as the family grows


If you have always dreamed about becoming a professional nanny with a natural gift bonding with children, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply Now

Hit Apply, or send your updated resume and introduction outlining why you'd be the perfect fit to hello@miniconnections.com.au. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Společnost EURONA s.r.o., hledá do týmu kolegu či kolegyni, které baví kombinace dat, kreativy a viditelných výsledků. Hledá člověka, který chce být součástí týmu přímo na pracovišti a vyhovuje mu každodenní spolupráce v kanceláři. Tato pozice není určena pro práci formou home office ani remote spolupráce, a to ani částečně.

Jedná se o pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na dobu neurčitou, pružná pracovní doba. Nástup možný ihned.
Pozice je vhodná i pro absolventy/absolventky.

Co Vás u nás čeká: správa a rozvoj firemních profilů na sociálních sítích (Facebook, Instagram) a firemního webu; plánování, tvorba a publikace obsahu včetně Reels, videí, fotografií a textů; vyhodnocování výkonnosti kampaní a příspěvků, práce s daty a návrhy na zlepšení; spolupráce na tvorbě a realizaci marketingové a obsahové strategie; samostatné vedení svěřených projektů a odpovědnost za jejich včasné dokončení; tvorba marketingových textů, korektury tiskovin, obalů a etiket produktů; správa produktového obsahu na webu, zadávání novinek, akcí a dalších marketingových aktivit.

Co od Vás očekáváme: zkušenosti nebo orientaci v online marketingu a sociálních sítích; analytické myšlení a schopnost pracovat s daty a vyhodnocovat výsledky; cit pro obsah, vizuální komunikaci a moderní trendy na sociálních sítích; spolehlivost, aktivitu a chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady; schopnost efektivně spolupracovat v týmu a být součástí každodenního dění ve firmě; možnost a ochotu vykonávat práci každodenně na pracovišti zaměstnavatele (pozice neumožňuje home office ani práci na dálku).

Co Vám nabízíme: zajímavou a různorodou práci s možností vidět konkrétní výsledky své práce; stabilní zázemí prosperující české společnosti; práci v přátelském a neformálním kolektivu; prostor pro vlastní iniciativu, nápady a profesní rozvoj; motivační finanční ohodnocení; příspěvek na stravování a penzijní nebo životní pojištění.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager Airports
jobs.description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.

jobs.title: Home and Office Cleaner
jobs.description:
Hyvinkään Kotisiivous Oy currently has approximately 180 regular cleaning customers per month, most of whom are private households in Hyvinkää and the surrounding areas. About 10 of these are business customers, in addition to a few stairwell cleaning sites. During the summer season, additional work mainly consists of cleaning windows and balcony glazing.

Workdays usually begin in the morning at the office, from where employees travel to the cleaning sites using the companys vans, and return to the same location at the end of the workday. For this reason, a valid driving licence and good driving skills for operating a van are required. Cleaning work at the sites is carried out mainly using the companys own cleaning products and equipment.

The companys current working languages are English and Finnish. These languages are also used as the customer service languages in the office, depending on the cleaners level of Finnish language skills. The job of a cleaner requires good physical endurance as well as strong mental resilience, as the expectations of several different customers must be met every day. The job requirements are introduced during a three-week training period, after which the employee continues working together with a more experienced cleaning pair.

Company can arrange a housing benefit in the center of Hyvinkää if needed.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
