jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Employer: Bloomfield Hospital Location: Stocking Lane, Rathfarnham Dublin 16, Ireland Hours of work per week: 39 hours weekly/78 hours fortnightly About Bloomfield: Bloomfield Hospital provides a spectrum of neuropsychiatric services to adults with a range of severe and enduring mental health needs such as Alzheimer`s, Parkinson`s, and Huntington`s Diseases, as well as individuals with early onset dementias, schizophrenia and mood disorders. We are the only facility in Ireland that provides a high level of specialized care for people with Huntington’s disease. In Bloomfield Hospital there is a focus on creating a therapeutic environment by using recovery-oriented clinical practices and therapeutic interventions, which are evidence-based to enable and support patients to achieve their highest level of functioning and quality of life. Description & Responsibilities: Wash patients in bed shower or bath as required. Making beds. Help patients/residents to dress. Lift, move, turn, and re-position patients, using the appropriate equipment at all times. Care of incontinent, colostomy, and ileostomy patients. Supervise incontinent, colostomy, and ileostomy patients in toilets, on commodes, and in bathrooms and assist with appropriate hygiene and incontinence wear. Give and remove bedpans, urinals, and commodes as required. Record and monitor bowel function, measuring urinary output, output from IDC, and urostomy. Notify nursing staff throughout the shift. Understand, assist, and promote patients’ oral hygiene including denture care. Care for patients’ hair and nails as required. Shave male patients. Mobilise and help patients to exercise as required. Ensure the comfort and safety of patients are met as per local policy. Assist patients/residents as per care plan with nutritional intake and record keeping of same. Assist nurses with procedures when necessary. Weigh patients using appropriate equipment specific to the patient’s/resident’s needs. Record, inform, and report to nursing staff. Give and remove emesis containers and sputum cartons. Understand the basics of skin integrity and promote and maintain the same through positive interventions. Maintain active communication with nursing staff. Assist the nursing staff with pressure sore prevention and care. Person Specification: The successful candidate will have completed a QQI Level 5 or Fetac 5 (8 modules) in Healthcare or Pre-Nursing or similar Nursing Qualification. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience. Previous experience in a psychiatric environment is an advantage. Care Skills and Care Support are essential. Our benefits include: Generous shift premiums (25% night duty, double time Sundays and bank holidays). Contributory pension. Fixed roster patterns. Further education supports available. Comprehensive training. Free onsite staff parking. Subsidised restaurant. Employee assistance programme. Uniforms supplied on commencement of employment. Cycle to work Scheme

Etsimme autollista lähihoitajaa kotihoitoon kokoaikaiseen, vakituiseen kaksivuorotyöhön.

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Nordvest Bemanning AS er på utkikk etter dyktige forskalingssnekkere til spennende prosjekter innen bygg og anlegg. Vi søker etter 5-10 personer som kan inngå i et utleieoppdrag hos vår kunde. Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

jobs.title: Produktförvaltare Data till Produktförvaltning
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och stärka hur Ålandsbanken arbetar med datakvalitet, datastyrning och uppföljning inom finansieringsområdet? Vi söker nu en Produktförvaltare Data som vill bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt och skapa långsiktig nytta för både verksamheten och våra kunder. I rollen får du en central position i utvecklingen av hur data används, kvalitetssäkras och följs upp inom banken. Du bidrar till att vår data är korrekt, spårbar och ändamålsenlig – både för affärsstyrning, rapportering och regulatoriska krav.

Din roll

Som Produktförvaltare Data ingår du i Produktförvaltningens processeffektiviseringsteam. Här får du en viktig roll i att utveckla arbetssätt, kontroller och uppföljning som stärker bankens användning av data. I nära samarbete med verksamheten, Data Governance och IT bidrar du till att omsätta behov och krav till praktiska lösningar som skapar värde i det dagliga arbetet.

I rollen arbetar du bland annat med att:

- Utveckla, definiera och följa upp kontroller för datakvalitet, dataflöden och affärsregler.

- Identifiera och driva förbättringar som gör data mer tillförlitlig, spårbar och användbar.

- Samverka med olika delar av organisationen, framför allt verksamheten, Data Governance och IT.

- Medverka i kravställning, testning, prioritering och uppföljning kopplat till regelverk, rapportering och verksamhetens behov.


Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete med data, analys, informationshantering eller uppföljning och som har god förståelse för processer, interna kontroller och hur krav kan omsättas till fungerande arbetssätt.

Du har högskoleutbildning med system- eller ekonomisk inriktning, alternativt motsvarande relevant arbetserfarenhet. Eftersom vårt arbetsspråk är svenska behöver du behärska svenska väl i både tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet, särskilt inom finansieringsområdet. Tidigare kunskap inom finansieringsområdet och goda kunskaper i engelska ser vi också som värdefullt.

Din profil

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är strukturerad, analytisk och initiativrik. Du har förmåga att driva frågor framåt, skapa struktur i en roll under utveckling och kommunicera tydligt och pedagogiskt med både verksamhet och tekniska intressenter. Du samarbetar gärna tvärfunktionellt, anpassar dig till ändrade förutsättningar och motiveras av att förstå samband, förbättra flöden och skapa lösningar som gör verklig nytta för både verksamheten och bankens kunder.

Om du vill kombinera verksamhetsförståelse, data, analys och förändringsarbete i en roll med hög påverkan, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Att bli en del av oss

Som del av vårt team får du vara med där det händer. Vi erbjuder dig en engagerad arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med ett ambitiöst och lösningsfokuserat team. Arbetet är intressant med mångsidiga arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom finansieringsområdet.

Här kan du läsa mer om vad vi erbjuder dig som blir en del av laget Ålandsbanken!

https://www.alandsbanken.ax/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Mariehamn)

https://www.alandsbanken.fi/sv/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Helsingfors)

Vill du veta mer?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Mariehamn eller Helsingfors.

Närmare upplysningar kring tjänsten ges av Avdelningschef Johanna Beeks, Johanna.Beeks@alandsbanken.fi.

Sista ansökningsdag för tjänsten är den 16.08.2026. Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

The Child and Family Agency was established on 1st January 2014 and is responsible for a range of statutory functions including provision of child protection, alternative care, specified regulatory services and a range of family support services. Further information is available on www.tusla.ie The policy of the Child and Family Agency to enable children to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. In circumstances where this is not possible, Residential Care incl. Special Care remains a valuable option for children who cannot be cared for at home. Entry requirements: Be registered in the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained by CORU. or Hold a CORU approved Social Care Worker qualification and have applied for CORU registration (evidence of application will be necessary) or Hold one of the following qualifications and be committed to a pathway towards Social Care education: Youth and Community work qualification BA (Hons) Youth and Community Development BA (Hons) Psychology Addiction Studies (Level 7) BA (Hons) Counselling and Addiction Studies Disability Diploma (Primary Care) Degree in Social Science (minimum Level 7) Purpose of role: This programme involves 3 months classroom-based learning followed by 3 months’ work placement in Tusla Special Care Unit in Dublin. The purpose of the post is to provide the employee with on the job learning opportunities as a work-based learner in social care with access to shadow a social care worker, learn social care skills while providing direct administration support to the social care services that seeks to improve the health and social wellbeing of the service users within the context of local communities and children’s residential and special care services. On successful completion of the 6-month programme and evidence of competency assessment, you will be offered a permanent contract of employment Main duties and responsibilities: To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same. To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments. To be responsible for the organisation of personal documents, arrangements, information and finance on behalf of the young person. To liaise with the parent, family, general services and other agencies on behalf of the young person. To attend meetings in relation to the care and developments of the young person. To undertake various aspects of home management including the household budget, upkeep and cleaning.

Tutora er en innovativ og voksende virksomhed, som tilbyder privat lektiehjælp til elever i folkeskolen og gymnasiet både online og fysisk. Vi tror på, at den rette undervisning kan gøre en verden til forskel, og derfor søger vi engagerede og dygtige tutorer, som vil være med på vores tutorteam.

  • Dansk

  • Matematik

  • Nat.vid. fag (fysik, kemi, biologi m.m.)

  • Humanistiske og samf.vid. fag (engelsk, samfundsfag, tysk m.m.)

  • Løbende kommunikation med elever og forældre om fremskridt, planlægning m.m.

  • Har stærke faglige kompetencer inden for et eller flere af de ovennævnte fag.

  • Er tålmodig, engageret og brænder for at hjælpe andre med at lære.

  • Kan tage ansvar og administrere et undervisningsforløb fra start til slut selvstændigt og pålideligt.

  • Har erfaring med undervisning eller tutoring (ikke et krav, men en fordel).

  • En meningsfuld og givende rolle, hvor du kan gøre en forskel.

  • Et støttende og venligt arbejdsmiljø.

jobs.description:
Sveps ungdomsverkstaden lediganslår ett vikariat inom uppsökande ungdomsarbete 25.9.2026-17.9.2027.

Som anställd inom det uppsökande ungdomsarbetet är dina arbetsuppgifter att handleda och stöda unga som saknar arbete eller studieplats. Du arbetar utgående från den ungas behov och förutsättningar, stöder de unga i bl.a. vardags- och livshanteringsfrågor, hjälpa dessa finna de tjänster som de är i behov av samt förbereder den unga att ta emot rätt sorts stöd. Arbetet är självständigt i dialog med den unga, med ett nära samarbete med uppsökande teamet samt med Sveps övriga personal.

Som uppsökare förutsätts du ha god kännedom om samhällets välfärdstjänster, erfarenhet av nätverksarbete och god samarbetsförmåga. Du förväntas ha en god kompetens i bemötande av personer i olika livssituationer och med olika bakgrund. Du bör ha utmärkta kunskaper i svenska (muntligt och skriftligt) samt förmåga att arbeta på finska.

Vi önskar att du har högskoleexamen och mångårig arbetserfarenhet inom det pedagogiska, sociala området eller annan lämplig bransch. Vi uppskattar speciellt erfarenhet av arbete med unga.

För att kunna genomföra ett gott arbete skall du ha god initiativförmåga och arbeta lösningsorienterat.

Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande och intressant arbete i en trevlig arbetsgemenskap i centrala Helsingfors.

jobs.description:
Job Title / Designation: Business Partner HR (Sales)

Department: Human Resource Functional

Reporting to: General Manager - HR, Administratively Reporting to: Head of Sales

Location: Multiple

Job Purpose

Build strong connect with sales team to effectively partner in building the right values-based culture.

Responsible for driving core HR processes efficiently and effectively with the sales team to create healthy work environment.

Ensure capability building for the sales team as per development needs & company priorities and create a performance-oriented work culture

Drive effective communication and engagement to ensure that the team is motivated to deliver. ï Manage Employee related Headcount, tracking and expenses.

Ensure Bench Planning and hiring of right talent to drive the sales agenda for the region

Data collection, consolidating and analyzing to draw up regular reports to help drive relevant action.

Provide effective HR/ personnel/ administrative support to the region sales team

Primary Roles & Accountabilities

Core HR Processes: Ensure flawless execution of the following Core people processes

Performance Management process â

  • Objective Setting of the entire team are SMART & in line with AOP, business & people priorities.
  • Midyear Review- Ensure MYR is done between manager & employee to provide directions on the progress
  • Annual Appraisal- Ensure PDRs are well written, onus for calibration of the region team and fitting the bell curve. Compilation of data to ensure high quality Calibration and pay for performance
  • Focal Point Discussion- Ensure this happens between manager, employee & HR and employee is provided feedback with relevant data and developmental inputs.

Management Connect Survey â Ensure participation by providing correct data and effective administration and follow-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to share scores & drive action planning.

Org. Health survey â Ascertain employee participation by ensuring accuracy in data and effective administration and follow-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to bring out insights, create & drive action planning.

People Planning process â Coach the team and build CDAPs for the region team. Support the RM in building people plan for the region team and ensure that the movements are in line with the people planning process. Implement the development action plan in line with employees CDAP.

PMP Survey â Ensure participation of the region team and take corrective action as per employee feedback.

Staffing

  • Responsible for recruitment in the Region â Channel Wise (Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, Wholesale, Up Country) supporting region business plan in each of the channel up to L05 in the region. (Sales Trainee to Area Sales Manager)
  • Own the staffing and recruitment process from end to end (manpower planning, sourcing, joining --> on Boarding) for upto L05 level. Support the induction for L6+ population for the region.
  • Internal Job Posting â Own up the IJP for the region (L01- L05 level)
  • Maintain employee number as per the AOP and track it on a monthly basis
  • Ensure minimal man-day loss on account of employee exit and replacement, quick turnaround.
  • Bring in diversity of talent in the team by hiring diverse workforce from different facets.
  • Ensure that the Exit interview is done and analysis of same is fed back to the relevant process/ system.

Employee Engagement & Culture Building

  • Be an employee champion - Reach out to the frontline to ensure good connect and resolve frontline issues in minimum time.
  • Own the R&R for the region â ROH as per plan, Area Manager of the month, Customer Executive of the month, family day, creating excitement by creating/rolling out appropriate regional contests (rollout of national contests as per BU plan)
  • Partner with the RM to nominate the high performing sales employees for regional/national/international ROH
  • Own up the engagement agenda for the region as per the agreed plan and ensure high employee involvement.
  • Set up appropriate two way communication channel with the frontline.
  • Ensure that all relevant HR processes are communicated to the frontline and build a strong PepsiCo Employer Proposition.
  • Drive the organizational Values and Code of Conduct to the frontline through appropriate communication, highlighting deviation and being the role model themselves.

Capability Building

Drive organization capability agenda in partnership with RM & BU HR - Ensure employee development as per development needs highlighted thru Performance management process & People planning. Follow 70:20:10 principle.

Create Performance improvement plan with RM for the people in concern area.

Implementation of change initiatives and supporting continuous improvement in sales function.

Facilitate delivery of development and training activities for employees and monitor effectiveness for business results as per the requirement.

Administration and MIS

  • Generate, own and maintain various People Process reports/ records/ analysis and must Win Battles Report. Send the reports to HO as per timelines and as required and drive appropriate action plans in partnership with RM & BUHR
  • Ensure that relevant HR Admin support is provided to the employees in a timely manner
  • Own up the Third Party Resources (TDO- SPO, Admin resources): Process Ownership ( T&E, Salary, Imprest, Grievance handling, complete control and processing)

Skill/Attributes/Work Experience

  • Ability to anticipate, prioritize and Multitask
  • Interpersonal relations â Collaboration and expectation management of the line
  • Expert in productive communication â Be able to influence and impact without formal power
  • Know the business â Good understanding of the sales levers
  • Functional Excellence - Good understanding of HR processes
  • Process Orientation â Be able to maintain process integrity
  • High Value Orientation with strong Drive and Execution orientation
  • High Learning Agility & high Customer Orientation

Súčasťou tejto práce je taktiež:

Pravidelná technická údržba, čistenie a nastavovanie strojnotechnologických zariadení ČOV, odstraňovanie bežných prevádzkových porúch a spolupráca s externými servisnými technikmi.

Zabezpečovanie a výkon odborných činností v oblasti ochrany životného prostredia (vodné hospodárstvo, čistenie odpadových vôd, nakladanie s odpadmi, ochrana ovzdušia).

Monitorovanie a vyhodnocovanie kvality odpadových vôd, účinnosti čistenia a technologických ukazovateľov; vedenie evidencie a spracovanie pravidelných hlásení pre úrady a interné potreby.

Sledovanie a hodnotenie environmentálnych aspektov a rizík vyplývajúcich z výroby a návrh opatrení na ich minimalizáciu.

Navrhovanie optimalizačných a technických riešení, spolupráca pri príprave a posudzovaní projektovej dokumentácie.

Poskytovanie odbornej súčinnosti interným oddeleniam, školenie zamestnancov v oblasti environmentálnych požiadaviek a kontrola dodržiavania predpisov na pracovisku.

Zabezpečenie súladu činností spoločnosti s platnou legislatívou.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti stratégie a rozvoja
jobs.description:
Obchod nie je len o predaji. Je o dôvere, vzťahoch a príležitostiach. Do nášho tímu hľadáme človeka, ktorý vie nadväzovať nové kontakty, budovať dlhodobé partnerstvá a hľadá riešenia, ktoré prinášajú spokojnosť klientom aj výsledky spoločnosti. Ak máš obchodného ducha, baví ťa komunikácia a chceš pracovať v prostredí hotelierstva, kongresov a eventov, radi ťa spoznáme. Čo bude tvojou úlohou? - aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti a získavať nových klientov, - budovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé vzťahy s obchodnými partnermi, - prezentovať hotel a naše služby firemným klientom, agentúram a organizátorom podujatí, - pripravovať obchodné ponuky na mieru a viesť obchodné rokovania, - spolupracovať s jednotlivými oddeleniami hotela pri realizácii podujatí, - sledovať trendy na trhu a prichádzať s novými obchodnými príležitosťami, - podieľať sa na plnení obchodných cieľov a ďalšom rozvoji hotela, - organizovať konferencie, firemné stretnutia, oslavy aj výnimočné eventy.
Výhody:ubytovanie, Prémie 25 percent zo základného platu 1400 €, t.j. do 350 € podľa prémiového poriadku spoločnosti. Štvrťročné odmeny na základe dosiahnutého hospodárskeho výsledku. Čo ponúkame? ✨ Prácu, pri ktorej budeš stretávať zaujímavých ľudí a podieľať sa na realizácii výnimočných podujatí. Okrem toho môžeš očakávať: - stabilné zázemie úspešnej spoločnosti, - motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie vrátane bonusovej zložky, - priestor na vlastnú iniciatívu a realizáciu nápadov, - profesionálny tím, ktorý si navzájom pomáha, - možnosti odborného a kariérneho rastu, - zamestnanecké benefity a zvýhodnené využívanie hotelových služieb, - príjemné pracovné prostredie Prečo práve Kubínska Resorts? Sme Kubínska Resorts – spoločnosť, ktorá zastrešuje tri jedinečné hotely. Každý z nich má svoj charakter, klientelu aj príbehy. Práve preto u nás nezažiješ stereotyp. Jeden deň pripravuješ obchodné stretnutie pre firemnú konferenciu, kongres, ďalší teambuilding či firemnú lyžovačku. Hľadáme človeka, na ktorého sa môžeme spoľahnúť. Obchodný manažér je partnerom nielen našich klientov, ale aj celého tímu. Oceníme zodpovednosť, spoľahlivosť, schopnosť dotiahnuť veci do konca a prirodzený cit pre budovanie dlhodobých vzťahov. Ak si energický, rád komunikuješ, nebojíš sa výziev a baví ťa rozmanitá práca, u nás dostaneš priestor realizovať vlastné nápady, ovplyvňovať obchodné výsledky a byť súčasťou spoločnosti, ktorá sa neustále rozvíja. Nehľadáme len kolegu. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý chce rásť spolu s nami. Ak si sa v tomto opise našiel našla, pošli svoj životopis. Tešíme sa, že sa spoznáme.

Na tejto pozícii prepojíte dva svety – vo fľaškovni sa postaráte o bezproblémový chod a nastavenie našej modernej plniacej a etiketovacej linky, zatiaľ čo mimo nej budete sprevádzať turistov a s hrdosťou prezentovať vína Villa Vino Rača zahraničným návštevám v anglickom alebo čínskom jazyku. Ak hľadáte stabilitu a prostredie, kde víno nie je len produkt, ale skutočná vášeň, radi Vás privítame v našom tíme!

Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti
•    Technické myslenie a zručnosť (nebojíte sa zobrať do ruky náradie).
•    Zmysel pre detail – neujde vám krivo nalepená etiketa ani neštandardný zvuk motora.
•    Zodpovednosť, dochvíľnosť a schopnosť pracovať samostatne.
•    Komunikatívnosť.
•    Proklientsky prístup.
•    Plynulá znalosť mandarínskej čínštiny a angličtiny (hovorená aj písomná).
•    Kultúrna znalosť čínskych trhov a spotrebiteľských trendov.
•    Fyzická zdatnosť (práca si vyžaduje pohyb a manipuláciu s materiálom).
•    Schopnosť rýchlo sa učiť a zachovať chladnú hlavu pri riešení technických problémov.
•    Vzťah k vínu a úcta k poctivej vinárskej tradícii.

Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity
•    Stabilná práca v renomovanom slovenskom vinárstve s istotou dlhodobého zamestnania.
•    Gastrokarta, ktorá ponúka stravné vo výške 9,30 €/deň (s príspevkom zamestnanca 1,50 €).
•    Kompletné pracovné oblečenie pre letné aj zimné obdobie.
•    Zamestnanecká zľava na naše vína.
•    Práca v priateľskom kolektíve, kde si navzájom pomáhame.
•    Pracovná doba: Pondelok až piatok: 7:00 hod – 15:30 hod (vrátane prestávok na oddych a občerstvenie). Voľné víkendy!
•    Zmluva na 1 rok s automatickým predĺžením na dobu neurčitú.

Vašou každodennou úlohou bude:
•    Nastavovanie a kalibrácia: Príprava a prestavovanie plniacej linky pre rôzne formáty fliaš a typy etikiet.
•    Technický dozor: Riešenie drobných technických porúch a bežná údržba strojového vybavenia.
•    Obsluha a plynulý chod: Zabezpečenie bezproblémového chodu výroby a dohľad nad prácou na linke.
•    Dohľad nad kvalitou: Kontrola fliaš, správneho nasadenia uzáverov a precízneho nalepenia etikiet (aby každá fľaša vyzerala perfektne).
•    Príprava na expedíciu: Balenie hotových produktov do kartónov, ukladanie na palety a práca s paletizačnou technikou.
•    Sanitácia: Udržiavanie čistoty a hygienických štandardov v priestoroch fľaškovne (čistota je u nás na prvom mieste).
•    Reprezentácia a degustácie: Sprevádzanie domácich i zahraničných turistov po vinárstve a odborná prezentácia našich vín v anglickom alebo čínskom jazyku.

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.description:
Harvey Nash USA has been engaged to find a talented HR Operations Specialist for a leading healthcare organization committed to delivering exceptional employee experiences through operational excellence.


Job Title: HR Operations Specialist

Location: Remote (California Residents Only)

Duration: 6-Month Contract


About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused HR Operations Specialist to join a dynamic HR team. This role is responsible for supporting a wide range of HR operations and employee inquiries while ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality service delivery. The ideal candidate is resourceful, takes ownership of their work, communicates effectively, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Review HRIS transactional process requests daily and weekly, approving or rejecting transactions based on established HR policies and procedures.
  • Understand core HR policies and processes to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant transaction processing.
  • Escalate complex transactional issues and policy-related questions to HR leadership when appropriate.
  • Manage employee HR cases, calls, and chats involving benefits, compensation, wellness programs, leave of absence, payroll, performance management, and other HR-related inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional HR teams including Benefits, Payroll, HR Technology, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Retirement, Eligibility, and Corporate Real Estate to resolve employee issues.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service by managing cases with accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism while enhancing the employee experience.
  • Identify trends in employee inquiries and partner with leadership on process improvements or escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted HR resource while ensuring compliance with organizational policies and service standards.


Must-Have Skills

  • Resourceful and self-sufficient with the ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and a growth mindset by learning quickly and embracing feedback.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-first approach.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and employee support functions.
  • Experience handling HR service requests or HR operations in a shared services or HR support environment.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Oracle HCM.
  • Experience with UKG (Ultipro) and/or ServiceNow.
  • Passion for Human Resources with broad HR knowledge; SHRM-CP certification is a plus.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting multiple HR Centers of Excellence.


Education

  • Associate's or bachelorâs degree in human resources or a related field OR 5+ years of HR experience in lieu of a degree.


A reasonable, good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum hourly wage for this position is $25.00 - $29.00 per hour on W2, depending on experience.


About Us

Harvey Nash is a national, full-service talent management firm specializing in technology and professional staffing. Our company was founded with a mission to serve as the talent partner of choice by connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations across a wide range of industries.

jobs.title: Traveler Care Specialist Luxury Travel
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Established in 2008, Zicasso is the most-reviewed and highest-rated luxury travel company, specializing in immersive custom tours, vacations, and safaris. Our Zicasso travel specialists are the worldâs top 2% of boutique tour operators and travel agents, pre-vetted and handpicked to compete in creating itineraries tailored to each of our travelersâ unique preferences. Joining Zicasso, you'll play a key role in bringing our travelersâ dreams to lifeâpushing the boundaries of whatâs possible with luxury travel experiences.

As a member of our team, youâll be part of a company recognized for its strong brand reputation among discerning travelers. Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and CondÃ© Nast Traveler, to name a few. See our press coverage here.

We are a fully remote company spanning five continents, and we foster a dynamic, progressive global work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We're seeking passionate, data-driven individuals who thrive in a high-performance environment and are eager to contribute to our innovative company culture, underpinned by a consistent pursuit of excellence, integrity, and teamwork.

Our global team comes together biannually for international retreats and summits. These are typically held for a week at a new location each time, providing opportunities to share ideas, collaborate in person, and strengthen our culture, all while learning firsthand about the destinations we serve. These events embody our commitment to both professional growth and the transformative power of travel.

Join us in shaping the future of luxury travel while working towards our visionâcreating a more connected humanity through travel. To learn more, visit https://www.zicasso.com/careers.


The Role

Currently, we are seeking a highly motivated, customer service-minded Traveler Care Specialist who embraces an entrepreneurial spirit and has a passion for international travel!

This role will be working at the intersection of our travelers and Zicassoâs global network of travel providers (partners), making both sides delighted with Zicassoâs unique matching service and will be responsible for assessing and processing incoming travel inquiries via email/messaging, phone, and online. You will learn to understand analytics and help ensure that we are maximizing the potential of our leads. You will build trusted relationships with our travelers to understand their travel needs and ensure these needs are being met and their expectations exceeded. This position plays a key role towards driving loyalty and repeat bookings of our most valued travelers.

This is an international, fully remote, freelance contractor position, working from home with a 5-day workweek that includes rotating weekend shifts. Initial training (3 to 4 weeks) will take place Monday through Friday.Â 

This role is open to candidates located outside of the United States, with a strong preference for those based in Argentina, Costa Rica, Brazil, and Colombia.

The work will all be conducted in English.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide exceptional customer service to travelers by taking ownership of their inquiries and becoming a trusted advisor throughout their use of Zicasso services. This includes assessing and solving incoming traveler inquiries via phone, live chat, messages and email.
  • Build trusted, long-lasting relationships with discerning luxury clients to strengthen their confidence in Zicasso. This involves assisting and serving clients in a way that meets their needs and exceeds their expectations.
  • Ensure a high level of inquiry conversion by demonstrating expertise in consultation, product knowledge, and the benefits of using Zicasso. This includes speaking with travelers via phone calls (and sometimes video), helping them understand how Zicasso works, and providing guidance for their travel needs.
  • Participate cross-functionally with the Partnerships, Product, and Marketing teams to integrate best practices and solutions for the client's experience and/or issues that may arise.
  • Partner with the Care Team leadership on projects and initiatives to solve problems and create innovative solutions.
  • Leverage Zicassoâs data, analytics and technologyÂ  to set new standards for customer success, driving innovation and excellence for the luxury travel industry.
  • Provide consultation and advice to move general inquiries to destination-specific trip requests.
  • Coach and mentor team members as needed.

Please Note: Weâre seeking highly-motivated candidates. Those who excel in this role will be given the opportunity to take on increasingly complex projects and initiatives, and grow their role and responsibility within the Traveler Care Team.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in the travel industry, with a focus on travel sales or operations of luxury tours or hotels. Examples of relevant experience include tour leader, tour director, hotel front desk, client relations, or guest services
  • Passionate about travel, with extensive experience traveling abroad and a strong curiosity about new international destinations.
  • Strong customer service-focused skills, with a passion for building strong relationships with travelers. This includes being comfortable with telephone-based work as a key part of the role.
  • Excellent fluency in oral and written English.
  • A cheerful and confident person who is adaptable to different styles of communication and traveler behaviors.
  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic, with a willingness to put in extra effort in a start-up environment to drive company success.
  • Comfortable with technology and able to quickly learn and adapt to the use of new software. Thorough knowledge of Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) (e.g. Docs, Sheets, Slides) is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, striving to achieve quality, error-free work.
  • Work flexible hours, including weekends, evenings, and holidays.
  • A Bachelor's degree or higher is preferred.


What We Offer:

  • Remote work from your home base and flexible hours that allow you to enjoy a great work-life balance.
  • Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions.
  • Learning and development annual stipend.
  • Enjoy two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!

If you are a customer service-minded problem solver with a passion for travel and a strong desire to make a difference, we strongly encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team and help shape the future of personalized, life-enriching travel experiences at Zicasso!

All applications should be submitted in English.


Our Commitment to Candidates

Zicasso is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicable to all locations, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities; if you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@zicasso.com.

At Zicasso, we value a highly personalized recruitment journey. For recruiting purposes, we may use AI tools to review, transcribe, and record application materials and interviews, but this is always under human review and judgment. All final hiring determinations are made exclusively by our hiring teams.

jobs.title: Project Administrator
jobs.description:
Bavarian Capital is adding a Project Administrator to support our ongoing coordination efforts for a major engagement with a leading Spanish telecommunications provider. This role ensures that our internal processes remain organized and that project timelines are managed with the precision our partners expect. By focusing on administrative clarity, you help maintain the high standards of documentation and scheduling that define our firm.

About the role
 As a Project Administrator, you will serve as a central point of coordination for the team, handling the logistical and administrative tasks that keep our projects moving forward. You will work closely with project leads to track progress, update documentation, and facilitate clear communication across different workstreams. This is an entry level position designed for someone who is highly organized and wants to start a career in project management within a professional investment firm. The role is fully remote, requiring a professional who can manage their tasks independently while staying connected with a distributed team.

What you will do
  • Maintain and update project schedules to ensure all milestones are recorded and visible to the team.
  • Organize and manage digital files and documentation related to the Spanish telecommunications engagement.
  • Prepare regular status reports that summarize project progress for internal reviews and meetings.
  • Coordinate internal meetings and ensure that all participants have the necessary materials and agendas beforehand.
  • Track project expenses and administrative tasks to assist with budget oversight and record keeping.
  • Assist with the drafting of internal updates to keep all team members informed of project developments.
  • Monitor project timelines to identify any potential delays early in the process and report them to leads.
  • Update internal databases and project management tools to reflect the most current information.


What we are looking for
  • A background in business administration, management, or a related field of study.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple administrative tasks simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Basic familiarity with standard project management tools and documentation software.
  • A methodical approach to work with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • The ability to work effectively and independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A reliable and professional attitude toward meeting deadlines and following internal instructions.
  • Proficiency in standard office applications for documentation, data entry, and scheduling.


What we offer
  • A permanent, full-time position within a stable and respected investment firm.
  • A fully remote working arrangement that supports professional autonomy and focus.
  • Competitive pay that reflects the responsibilities of the role and the current market.
  • Opportunities for professional development and learning within the project management field.
  • A professional home where your contributions to project efficiency are recognized.
  • Access to modern tools and systems that support reliable remote collaboration.
  • A calm and focused working environment free from the distractions of a traditional office.
  • The chance to work on large scale projects with significant international partners.


Working at Bavarian Capital
 Bavarian Capital is built on a foundation of reliability and long term thinking. We avoid the frantic pace often found in the investment sector, preferring instead to move with purpose and precision. This approach extends to how we manage our team, offering a high degree of professional autonomy and a clear, remote first structure. We believe that by providing a stable and respectful environment, our team members can focus on their craft and produce their best work. This role is a chance to start a career in an organization that values clarity, thoughtful decision making, and the sustainable growth of its people and its projects. We prioritize steady progress over short term trends, ensuring that every member of our team has a reliable and predictable path forward.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Description:

Tyvek® is a unique flash-spun nonwoven material renowned for its exceptional combination of lightweight performance,
durability, protection, and versatility. With leading market positions across construction, protective apparel, medical packaging,
and other high-growth industries, Tyvek® continues to shape the future of materials innovation worldwide.
At DuPont, you'll work at the heart of a proprietary technology that combines multiple engineering disciplines, including
chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, polymer science, material science, fluid dynamics, electrostatics, and process
technology.
This is an opportunity to join a company known for its strong safety culture, technological excellence, and commitment to
employee development, while contributing to products that make a real difference in people's lives.
What You'll Do
As a Process Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, innovation, and business growth within our
Tyvek® manufacturing operations.
You will:
• Own and continuously improve manufacturing processes, ensuring the highest standards in process safety, reliability,
quality, and environmental compliance.
• Provide daily technical support to production operations and help optimize line performance.
• Identify, develop, and implement process and technology improvements that enhance productivity, efficiency, and
sustainability.
• Contribute to major capital investment (CAPEX) projects, including process design, engineering calculations, and
technology implementation.
• Lead and participate in Process Hazard Analyses (PHA) and risk management activities.
• Collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges.
• Manage and maintain critical process technology documentation and standards.
• Support the future evolution of Tyvek® technology through innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.
At DuPont, no two days are the same. Your responsibilities and opportunities will evolve as our technologies, products, and
business continue to grow.
What We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, driven engineers who are passionate about technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree preferred in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Bachelor's degree with relevant industrial experience will also be considered.
• Fluent in German and English.
• Strong interest in manufacturing technology, industrial processes, and innovation.
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and develop new technical competencies.
• Self-starter with strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
• Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate across multiple disciplines and functions.
• French and/or Luxembourgish language skills are a plus.

jobs.title: Associate professor (promotion track) in Banking Law (m/f)
jobs.description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Department of Law
Job Number: UOL07790
Contract Type: Academic - Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week

Job (internal): Associate professor
Job Level: Monolevel
Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Expertise: Professors
Role Type: Open Position


About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

jobs.title: CFO HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (m/f)
jobs.description:
CFO HSBC Investment Funds (Luxembourg) S.A.

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business.

What you will do:

Reporting functionally to the Asset Management Continental Europe CFO and locally to the CEO of HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL), you will head the Finance function for HIFL, the HIFL Ireland Branch and the HIFL UAE Branch. You will ensure consistently high standards of financial control, reporting and executive insight. You will be a key member of the HIFL Local Management Committee and a standing attendee at key governance forums, presenting the HIFL's financial position to senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Head the Finance function across HIFL Luxembourg, HIFL Ireland Branch and HIFL UAE Branch, setting a high bar for financial control, reporting quality and decision support for executive stakeholders.
• Deliver accurate, timely and compliant Group reporting, producing clear, executive-ready MI and ad hoc insight for stakeholders including the AMEU CFO.
• Own end-to-end statutory reporting: prepare IFRS financial statements aligned to Asset Management standards and maintain strong ledger integrity, including oversight of postings to the HIFL ledger.
• Direct the audit cycle end-to-end, coordinating auditors to meet all deliverables on time and to a high standard.
• Drive a robust balance sheet and cost base: ensure reconciliations are complete and well-evidenced; oversee operational budgets for fund ranges; maintain accurate accruals and invoice governance, keeping forecasts aligned to business changes.
• Provide effective financial stewardship and risk oversight: submit local regulatory returns; validate management fee calculations and intercompany payaways to ensure fair revenue allocation across AMG sites; act as TPEM and/or Risk Steward for suppliers where applicable.

You should apply if you have:

Responsive to national health priorities and connected to international networks, our researchers address major challenges in human health - from fundamental discoveries to professional practice. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing the training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The successful candidate will contribute to the strategic development and continuous advancement of the University's Medical Specialisation Programmes. The candidate will assist Directors of Studies in developing research ideas, preparing competitive project proposals and funding applications, analysing scientific and educational developments, and translating research outcomes into programme enhancement and innovation. The candidate will work closely with the Directors of Studies, academic and administrative staff, as well as other internal and external institutional stakeholders.

• Develop and implement programme evaluation strategies, analyse educational outcomes and generate evidence to support continuous quality improvement
• Contribute to scientific publications, reports, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities
• Monitor developments in healthcare, specialist medical training, research funding, healthcare policy, and relevant regulatory frameworks
• Support quality assurance, programme evaluation and accreditation processes of the Medical Specialisation Programmes
• Foster collaboration with national and international academic institutions, healthcare providers, professional organisations, and research networks

Your profile
• Master's degree in Medicine, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Medical Education, Public Health, Healthcare Management, Education, or another relevant discipline

• Experience in research project development, grant writing, project coordination, or higher education administration
• Demonstrated ability to prepare research proposals, funding applications, or strategic project documentation
• Strong analytical skills with experience in literature reviews, data analysis, and evidence synthesis
• Excellent scientific writing, reporting, and communication skills

jobs.title: 2. SPASILAC / SPASITELJICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 2. Naziv radnog mjesta: SPASILAC (m/ž) – 4 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, važeće uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,61 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: vrši nadzor vodene površine s kopna ili čamca te površine bazena, provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brinu za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši neprekidan nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, nadzire poštivanje bazenskog i plažnog reda, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, osigurava natjecanja na vodi te druge manifestacije u blizini vode, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže, uz spasilačke poslove, sudjeluje kao ispomoć realizatorima sportskih programa u provođenju sportskih programa, provjere plivanja i dr., prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, odgovoran je za stanje skladišta rekvizita i opreme, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5 % za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web-stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa (preslika uvjerenja) – za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 2., • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj bit će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. jobs.title: 100% Remote Technical Implementation Manager (Hotel PMS / CRS Integration Specialist) EN (Hotelfachmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hotel Revenue Manager; Hotel Systems Experte

Stellenbeschreibung:
Hotel PMS use Experience Required (please do not apply if you have never used a hotel PMS)

Location: Fully Remote (EU preferred – Spain / Portugal / Southern Europe or global if compatible with EOR or contractor setup)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Flexible Hours)
Experience Level: Experience with hotel systems required
Salary Range: €30.000 - 45.000

Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered automation systems for the hospitality industry.

Our platform automatically reads incoming reservation emails and generates tailored offers for guests.

Unlike many traditional hotel systems, we work entirely with live real-time data from PMS, CRS, IBE, and Channel Manager APIs. Because of this, stable integrations and accurate data flow are critical to our product.

This is where this role comes in.

Job Summary

Are you the person at the hotel everyone turns to when the PMS stops syncing, the channel manager misbehaves, or integrations break?  This can be a great transition role into hotel tech from hotel operations

We are looking for a Hotel Systems Integration Specialist to take ownership of technical connectivity and implementation for our hotel partners.

This role is focused specifically on integration execution and system connectivity. You will work closely with our Account Management and Support teams, but you will not be responsible for commercial account management or first-line customer support. Your primary responsibility is ensuring that integrations between hotel systems and our platform are configured, tested, and functioning reliably.

You will also play an important internal role by helping our developers understand new PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager integrations — translating vendor documentation, operational workflows, and real-world hotel requirements into clear technical specifications and test scenarios.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Own Technical Onboarding
Lead the technical setup and activation of new hotel clients on our platform.

Ensure Reliable Connectivity
Configure, test, and validate integrations between our system and hotel PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager environments.

Translate Hotel Requirements into Technical Specs
When hotels request specific workflows (e.g. reservation field mapping, folio posting rules, or company profile handling), analyze whether and how their PMS APIs support it.

Work with API Documentation & Testing Tools
Use tools like Postman to test API endpoints, validate responses, and confirm system behavior before implementation.

Bridge to Engineering
Translate integration findings into clear, actionable specifications and GitLab tickets for the engineering team.

Troubleshoot Integration Issues
Investigate and resolve connectivity problems such as synchronization errors, missing reservation data, or incorrect folio postings.

Guide Hotel Technical Teams
Support hotel IT, revenue, or operations teams through setup steps such as API authentication (e.g. Microsoft Graph) and simple DNS configuration (e.g. CNAME records).

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

Experience with Hotel Systems Required
Previous experience working with hotel systems (such as PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, or other hotel operations platforms) is required.

Interface (API) Curiosity & Documentation Skills
Ability to read and interpret API documentation and figure out how to validate behavior using tools like Postman.

Technical Comfort (No Coding Required)
Comfort working with structured data (JSON/XML), basic API concepts, and technical troubleshooting workflows.

Strong Communication Skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both hotel operational teams and technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving Mindset
You enjoy investigating why systems don’t work and prefer practical solutions over theoretical perfection.

Fluent English
Written and spoken.  No German required.

Nice to Have (We Can Teach You)

- Experience using Postman for API testing
- Basic understanding of DNS / CNAME configuration
- Experience with PMS vendors such as Mews, Opera, Cloudbeds, Protel, SiteMinder, D-EDGE, SynXis, or Apaleo
- Previous experience in hotel tech (PMS, Channel Manager, CRS, IBE vendors)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 weeks, you will be independently:

- Onboarding and configuring hotel system integrations
- Testing API endpoints and validating integration behavior
- Translating hotel requirements into clear technical specifications
- Creating actionable engineering tickets for integration work
- Supporting live troubleshooting of connectivity issues

Culture & Working Style

We are a fully remote, international team operating in a trust-based environment.

We value:

- Remote & flexibility first – work from anywhere, structure your day how it works best for you
- High autonomy with high responsibility – you own your work end-to-end
- Strong error culture – mistakes are expected as part of learning; we focus on fixing and improving, not blaming
- Respectful communication – direct feedback is welcome, personal attacks are not
- Pragmatism over perfection – we prefer working systems over theoretical perfection

We work in a fast-moving environment where clarity improves over time through iteration, not upfront perfection.

Benefits

- Fully remote position
- Flexible working hours
- Direct access to engineering and product teams
- High autonomy and ownership
- Opportunity to grow into technical product or engineering roles
- Equipment provided (laptop + accessories if needed)

How to Apply

Please send your application to: career@hotelresbot.com

Please include:

- CV or short professional background
- Brief cover letter explaining: - Your experience with hotel systems (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, etc.)
- Your comfort level with reading API documentation and using tools like Postman
- Why you are interested in hotel SaaS implementation and connectivity

Ergänzende Informationen:
Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Datenaustauschformat JSON, Tourismusplattformen und Buchungssysteme
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Hotelverwaltungs-, Reservierungssystem Opera, Reservierung (Hotel- und Gaststättengewerbe)
