jobs.title: Team Lead, Engineering
jobs.description:
**Team Lead, Engineering, FinVector**

**Are you looking for a new challenge where you can combine people leadership with technical and quality expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry?**

Whether you are looking for your next career step, seeking to expand your leadership responsibilities, or broaden your expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry, this role offers an excellent opportunity to gain new perspectives and further your professional development.

We are looking for a**Team Lead, Qualification**to join our**Qualification Team**in the Engineering department.

The Qualification Team plays a critical role in ensuring that our equipment, facilities, utilities, and associated computerized systems are properly tested, documented ,and approved for their intended use. This helps ensure that our operations meet Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements and are ready to support the production of high-quality gene therapy products.

The team is responsible for planning, coordinating and maintaining qualification activities throughout the lifecycle of facilities, equipment and systems, in accordance with regulatory requirements, company procedures and industry best practices.

As Team Lead, you will lead and develop a team of qualification professionals while providing direction, support and expertise in qualification-related activities. You will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams, contributing to both operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Key responsibilities**

- Lead, coach and develop the Qualification Team, supporting competence development and team performance

- Set priorities and allocate resources to ensure efficient execution of qualification activities and project deliverables

- Provide guidance and decision-making support on qualification-related topics, risks and issues

- Review and approve qualification documentation and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company procedures

- Support audits, inspections, investigations of process or documentation deviations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and change management activities

- Drive continuous improvement and foster effective collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality functions


**In order to succeed in this role, you should have:**

- A technical or scientific degree combined with relevant industry experience

- Previous experience in leading people or coordinating technical teams

- Experience in a regulated industry environment, such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, food production or another quality-driven industry

- Understanding of qualification, validation, quality assurance or technical compliance processes

- Knowledge of investigations, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and change management practices

- Strong planning, communication and problem-solving skills

- Fluent English and the ability to collaborate effectively with different stakeholders


Most importantly, you are a supportive leader who enables your team to succeed and is motivated by developing people, improving ways of working and contributing to high-quality GMP operations.

This is a permanent, full-time salaried employee position (37.5 hours per week). Our aim is for the selected candidate to start in the role during September–October, with some flexibility based on availability.

**What FinVector offers you**

Meaningful job in organization where your work truly matters for peoples health and where your work is valued. High competence, quality, teamwork, and transparency are emphasized in everything that is done at Finvector. In international organization you have great opportunities to grow and develop.

In addition to great colleagues and meaningful work, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare services, ePassi benefits for sports and cultural activities, a lunch benefit, and participation in our company-wide bonus scheme.

**How to apply**

Please submit your application via the link below by**9 August 2026**and attach your CV and application, including your salary expectation.

**For more information about the position,** please contact **Hiring Manager Lotta Rissanen**(+358 41 317 0975)during office hours in weeks 29-30. **During the Hiring Manager's holiday**weeks 31-32,please contact **Engineering Director Snorri Halldórsson**(+358 44 777 1410).

jobs.title: CRM Advisor
jobs.employer: LEGER UTEN GRENSER NORGE MEDECINS SANS FRONTIERES NORWAY
jobs.description:
Doctors Without Borders Norway (Leger Uten Grenser/MSF) is seeking a CRM Advisor to join our dedicated and collaborative CRM team working at the intersection of tech, data, and fundraising and help ensure sustainable funding for life-saving medical work worldwide.

This is a role for someone who wants to combine technical expertise with meaningful impact.

About the Position

As CRM Advisor, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our CRM capabilities, driving continuous improvement of workflows, data flows, and system integrations to support effective and scalable fundraising and engagement. The role combines technical tasks with advisory responsibilities. The main focus is to troubleshoot and optimize existing CRM flows and create new processes, while ensuring that donor data is accurate, accessible, and actionable, enabling data-driven insights for the fundraising department.

We are actively working to create an inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are committed to accessibility and are happy to make reasonable adjustments for candidates who may need them during the recruitment process and throughout employment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve and develop workflows in the CRM, including automation and integrations, and document processes.

  • Provide professional advice on process improvement and cost-effective solutions.

  • Collaborate with external suppliers on payment solutions and new integrations (e.g., Vipps and Mastercard).

  • Perform analyses and ensure data quality to support data-driven decisions, act as backup for the CRM Analyst.

  • Contribute to the strategic use of data in collaboration with the CRM Analyst and CRM & Loyalty Manager.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in relevant fields (information technology, informatics and computer science, finance and administration, etc.). Five years of relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

  • At least 2 years of experience with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) at a super user level or higher, including data analysis, and integrations.

  • Proficiency in SQL or a similar data querying/programming language

  • Experience in fundraising, project management, or analytical tools is an advantage.

  • Proficient in English (C1 and higher); Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and technical skills.

  • Structured, strategic, and detail-oriented.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • Quality-focused and goal-oriented.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic, international working environment where you’ll collaborate with an engaged and dedicated team.

  • The opportunity to be part of one of the world’s most recognised humanitarian organisations.

  • Real influence on and responsibility for developing CRM activities at Doctors Without Borders.

  • Flexible working hours with core hours from 09:00–15:00, and one day of home office per week.

  • Two additional days of annual leave.

  • Salary according to Doctors Without Borders’ salary principles, salary grade 15: NOK 622,742 - 687,428 per year (based on relevant experience).

  • Workplace: Oslo. Currently based at Hausmanns gate 6; relocating to Mølleparken 2 in early 2027.

At Doctors Without Borders, we value diversity and seek to have an inclusive and accessible work environment. We encourage all individuals who have the required qualifications to apply, independently of their ethnic, national, or cultural background, age, gender, sexual orientation, religious belief, disabilities, or other aspects of their identity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leger Uten Grenser er en nøytral og uavhengig medisinsk nødshjelpeorganisasjon som redder liv og lindrer nød. Vi hjelper de som trenger det mest - uansett hvem, uansett hvor, uansett hvorfor. Leger Uten Grenser har prosjekter i flere enn 75 land og sender feltarbeidere fra Norge på rundt 100 oppdrag hvert år. Leger Uten Grenser gir nødhjelp til mennesker i krig, kriser og katastrofer og andre som ikke har tilgang til grunnleggende helsetjenester. Vi varsler om overgrep og glemte kriser - fordi færre dør når flere vet.

jobs.title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.

More info at: www.europcar-mobility-group.com

jobs.title: Montør til Bruseglas og nicher
jobs.description:

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig medarbejder med håndværker erfaring til montering af bruseglas og nicher hos primært erhvervskunder på hele Sjælland. Du behøver ikke at være uddannet så længe du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på.

Erfaring med montagearbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du arbejder præcist, leverer høj kvalitet og sætter en ære i godt håndværk. Du vil få en grundig oplæring, hvor du de første 1½ måned følges med en erfaren kollega.

Du starter arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og modtager dagen før en arbejdsplan med dagens opgaver. Materialer hentes på vores lager i Roskilde cirka to gange om ugen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • Arbejde mandag til torsdag kl. 07.30–15.30 og fredag kl. 07.30–15.00.

  • Timeløn på 225 kr. Ved fastansættelse vil lønnen være højere.

  • Firmabil, værktøj, arbejdstøj og mobiltelefon stilles til rådighed.

  • Grundig oplæring og sparring med en erfaren kollega.

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse efter 3 måneders fuldtidsansættelse

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er bosat på Sjælland og kommer med noget håndværksmæssig erfaring.

  • Har gerne erfaring med montagearbejde eller fugning.

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Taler dansk eller engelsk.

  • Har kørekort B.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdsområde: Hele Sjælland (lager i Roskilde)

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt – vi ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Primary location:
ROVANIEMI

TARJOILIJA /KAHVILATYÖNTEKIJÄ
Rosso Rovaniemi /Coffee House Rovaniemi

Etsimme useita tarjoilijoita 40–75 h/3vk määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin talvisesonkiin 2026–2027 Rosso -ravintolaan ja Coffee House -kahvilaan. Määräaikaisuuden kestot ovat noin marraskuusta maaliskuulle, sovittavissa hakijan mukaan.

Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset
Olet ystävällinen, hymyasenteella varustettu tekijätyyppi, joka haluaa hurmata asiakkaamme yhdessä työkavereiden kanssa. Palvelumme on laadukkaan välitöntä ja autamme tiimissä toinen toistamme onnistumaan. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, ripeää mutta huolellista työskentelytapaa sekä myynnillistä asennetta.

Me Lapinmaan ravintoloissa valloitamme ihmiset hyvän palvelun, ruoan ja juoman avulla. Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta tarjoilu- ja kahvilatehtävistä, mutta välttämätöntä se ei ole - perehdytämme sinut työskentelymenetelmiin ja talon tavoille huolellisesti. Täysi-ikäisyys, vähintään sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito sekä vuorotyömahdollisuus ovat edellytyksiä tarjoilijan tehtäviimme. Toimimme keskellä vilkkainta turistikatua, joten kaikesta kielitaidosta ja kulttuurituntemuksesta on sinulle etua.

Tule töihin poikkeuksellisen hyvään porukkaan. Meillä saat enemmän kuin työpaikan – saat myös kattavat henkilöstöedut

Meillä se tarkoittaa mm:
📌 Osaavaa tiimiä ja saumatonta yhteistyötä, mikä tuntuu ja näkyy asiakkaille asti.
📌 Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista. Tämä tarkoittaa alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta. Eduista voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ
📌 Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen tuntipalkan (13,70 €/h-15,04 €/h), jonka muodostumiseen vaikuttaa alan kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
📌 Mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon, jopa 1,30 €/h. Isolla talolla on myös ison talon edut!

Tässä voi olla seuraava työpaikkasi, hae rohkeasti mukaan mahtavaan tiimiimme!
👉 Hakuaikaa on 31.8.2026 saakka. Kutsumme hakemuksien perusteella jatkoon valitut haastatteluun ja täytämme paikat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Åpen søknad:  2 Selgere søkes til [50%]
jobs.description:
Vi søker to selgere som trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Som selger i Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk hverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet. Hvis du har et lite konkurranseinnstinkt, tipper vi at du vil ha det gøy med alle salgskonkurransene vi kjører!

Hvem er du?
Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er

  • effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder

Hvorfor Narvesen?
Som en del av REITAN CONVENIENCE, har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!


Narvesen er den originale kiosken i Norge. Vi har vært en del av hverdagen til det norske folk siden 1894. I dag er vi en fleksibel, smidig og fremoverlent convenience-kjede som leder utviklingen fremover med stadig nye tanker, ideer og løsninger. Vi er der for dem som raskt og enkelt ønsker å forenkle hverdagen på en måte som gir god samvittighet. Våre kunder er på farten, og vi skal hjelpe dem med påfyll i en ellers så travel hverdag. Narvesen er en del av Reitan Convenience Norway.

jobs.title: Kombinert Utleierepresentant (deltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Sola lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres forløpende

Stillingsprosent: 40 - 60 prosent

Stillingsprosent kan tilpasses den rette kandidaten.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Data Labeling Specialists
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Workada creates high-quality labeled data for advanced technology systems. Our team reviews, organizes, categorizes, evaluates, and quality-checks digital content so those systems can better understand information and perform real-world tasks.
We believe careful data work matters. Every reviewed item, categorized example, and quality-checked task helps improve how technology interprets information, follows instructions, and responds in practical settings.

About You

We're hiring detail-oriented individuals who are comfortable working on a computer and interested in careful, focused digital work. We're especially interested in:

  • People who can carefully review written information, images, documents, or other digital content
  • Strong readers and writers with good judgment
  • People who can follow detailed instructions consistently
  • Individuals who are comfortable using web-based tools and online platforms
  • People who take quality seriously and can spot mistakes or inconsistencies
  • Those who enjoy focused, independent work while contributing to a larger project
  • Strong character matters — we value integrity, reliability, curiosity, and a commitment to high-quality work



Qualifications

  • Comfortable using a computer for extended periods
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to follow written guidelines and project instructions
  • Clear written communication skills
  • Basic familiarity with spreadsheets, online forms, or web-based work tools
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Prior experience in data labeling, annotation, quality review, research, writing, customer support, operations, or administrative work is helpful but not required



Compensation

Compensation is $18- $22 an hour and a max of 40 hours a week.

A Place to Do Meaningful Work

Data labeling may sound simple, but it plays an important role in improving the technology people use every day. At Workada, your work helps create the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

We're looking for people who care about accuracy, consistency, and careful judgment. Whether you're reviewing text, categorizing information, evaluating responses, or checking data quality, your work helps improve the way technology performs.

jobs.title: Butikschef
jobs.description:
Få nye udfordringer i en nystartet virksomhed med et stærkt fællesskab.

Vil du være en del af et nyt brand i Danmark – så søg ind til os i Hus og Hjem.

Vi har fællesskab og samarbejde som kerneværdier, da vi tror på, at godt arbejdsmiljø og glade kollegaer er med til at skabe en god kundeoplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig:

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor du vil komme til at spille en afgørende rolle i teamet. For at blive vores nye kollega skal du være god til at samarbejde, men også kunne tænke og arbejde selvstændigt samt tage ansvar. Du er resultatorienteret, serviceminded, har situationsfornemmelse og sans for god kundebetjening. Du formår at engagere dig og gå foran som det gode eksempel, er fleksibel og har en positiv indstilling til nye udfordringer, til kunderne og til kollegerne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå i sikre en altid indbydende og salgsklar butik med en høj standard.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling, og der vil være aften- og weekendarbejde.

Få en spændende og afvekslende hverdag med fuld fart på samt mulighed for gode og fleksible arbejdsforhold og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Kan du se dig selv i:

Du er medansvarlig for butikkens udvikling. Du sikrer, at der altid er den rette bemanding, og butikken løbende udvikles til at nå dens fulde potientiale.

Du er en yderst fleksibel og stabil medarbejder. Du ved, at du i en butik kan blive afbrudt, og arbejdsopgaverne kan ændre sig i løbet af dagen, samt at vi alle er afhængige af hinanden for at få butikken til at spille.

Du er ambitiøs. Du har lyst til at dygtiggøre dig, og lyst til at gøre dit bedste for at skabe et godt resultat. Derudover går du foran som det gode eksempel.

Du er imødekommende. Du ønsker at få andre til at føle sig godt tilpas i dit selskab, da du ved, at det er starten på god kollegaservice og en god kundeservice.

Du er en god kollega. Du ved, hvor vigtigt det er at være omgivet af gode kollegaer. Både socialt og fagligt. Du ønsker at hjælpe og støtte dine kollegaer, samt skabe god energi.

Du nyder at have direkte kundekontakt. Du formår at skabe tillid og forstå kunden. Du brænder for at give kunden en troværdig og god oplevelse. Sammen med dine dygtige kollegaer sørger du for, at kunden kommer igen.

Da vores koncept stammer fra Italien er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med import fra EU og udenfor EU.

Hvis jobbet som noget for dig, så skynd dig at sende din ansøgning, da vi holder samtaler løbende. Stillingen forventes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til os i Hus og Hjem på vores mail.

Retarus is a worldwide provider of cloud-based messaging solutions at enterprise scale. This makes Retarus a multicultural, multilingual, and engaging workplace. We are committed to creating a diverse and dynamic environment for our employees, with generous compensation, time off, and a global, collaborative workplace.

- Mobile working and flexible working time

- Flat hierarchies and great feedback culture

- Demonstrated hunter mentality with a clear focus on new business development and new customer acquisition.
- Resilience and persistence when facing initial market resistance and managing longer sales cycles.
- A collaborative, dependable working style that contributes to strong team fit and sustainable cooperation.

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
jobs.description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Director Sales and Key accounts
jobs.description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab Sjælland
jobs.description:
Hos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- og skimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør, der har lyst til en hverdag med ansvar, faglige udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab.
 
Som en del af vores team bliver du en vigtig brik i arbejdet med at begrænse skader og hjælpe kunderne godt videre. Vi ved, at en hurtig og professionel indsats kan gøre en stor forskel – både for bygninger og for de mennesker, der bliver berørt.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab får du en alsidig hverdag med opgaver hos både private kunder, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, men får også et stort selvstændigt ansvar i de enkelte opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok – uanset om opgaven er stor eller lille.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere om den bedste løsning for kunden

Derudover kan du også komme til at arbejde med

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og møder dine kolleger og kunder med en positiv indstilling.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en hverdag, hvor planerne kan ændre sig

  • Er en god holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Bor på Sjælland, så du har en rimelig afstand til de opgaver, du bliver tilknyttet

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige kompetencer og dine menneskelige kvaliteter. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen – uanset baggrund, køn eller erfaring.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Hver dag hjælper vi private, virksomheder og offentlige kunder med at begrænse skader og genetablere bygninger efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Sjælland

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette
kandidat.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt driftsleder Stefan Nissen på + tlf. +45 25 10 16 42.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

jobs.title: Product Support Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

 - This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).

 - Manage executive-level product escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.

 - The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.

 - Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.

 - Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.

 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross-functionally owned processes and tools.

 - Participate in the global on-call rotation to cover incidents.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of work experience in Product support team of a software company.

 - 3+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.

 - You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.

 - You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

 - You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

 - Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

 - You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

Hotelportier for Boutique Hotel Herman K
jobs.description:
Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

jobs.title: Renholdsmedarbeider (tilkallingsvikar) søkes til Oslo
jobs.description:
Om Four FM ❤️

Four FM leverer førsteklasses fasilitetsstyringsløsninger til selskaper som verdsetter sitt merke. Vi er et smidig selskap med en sterk entreprenørånd, dedikerte mennesker og en inkluderende kultur.

Om stillingen 📢

Vi søker nå en renholdsmedarbeider som tilkallingsvikar. Dette er en fleksibel stilling uten fast arbeidstid eller garantert stillingsprosent, hvor du blir kontaktet ved behov – for eksempel ved sykdom, ferie eller annet fravær hos våre kunder.

Stillingen passer godt for deg som ønsker en fleksibel jobb ved siden av studier eller annen arbeidssituasjon.

Du vil bli en del av et sammensveiset team med en engasjert leder, og bidra til å sikre et trygt og komfortabelt miljø gjennom høykvalitets renhold i produksjons- og kontorbygg i Oslo-området.

For riktig kandidat kan det på sikt være mulighet for mer faste vakter eller fast ansettelse.

Arbeidsoppgaver ✔

  • Daglig renhold av kontor- og produksjonslokaler.

  • Sikre høy kvalitet i leveransen.

  • Bidra til et rent, trygt og hygienisk arbeidsmiljø.

Kvalifikasjoner ✔

  • Erfaring fra renhold er en fordel, men ikke et krav – opplæring gis.

  • Du er pålitelig, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt.

  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner og jobber selvstendig.

  • Du kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk.

Arbeidssted 📍

Oslo.

Arbeidstid 🕐

  • Ingen fast arbeidstid eller garantert antall timer.

  • Du blir tilkalt ved behov.

  • Arbeidstidene kan variere mellom dag, kveld og helg.

  • Det kan forekomme perioder med mer faste vakter, for eksempel under ferieavvikling.

Ansettelsestype

Tilkallingsvikar / midlertidig ansettelse.

Søknadsfrist 📆

17.08.2026 (stillingen kan bli besatt tidligere).

Søknad 📩

Send inn din søknad på norsk, engelsk eller spansk.

Startdato

Så snart som mulig.

Four FM sin visjon – We take C.A.R.E. ❤️

Våre verdier er vårt moralske kompass. We take C.A.R.E. – Compassion, Attention, Respect og Excellence. Hvis du brenner for å gjøre en forskjell, trives i et støttende miljø og ønsker å bidra til en bedre arbeidsdag for våre kunder, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

🇬🇧 Cleaning Staff (On-Demand / Temporary) – OsloAbout Four FM ❤️

Four FM provides top-notch facility management solutions to companies that care about their brand. We are agile, entrepreneurial, and driven by dedicated people.

About the Role 📢

We are currently looking for a Cleaning Staff member on an on-demand basis. This is a non-permanent position with no guaranteed hours or fixed schedule, where you will be called in when needed – for example during sickness, vacations, or other absences.

This role is ideal for someone looking for a flexible job alongside studies or other commitments.

You will be part of a supportive team and play an important role in maintaining a clean, safe, and comfortable environment for our clients in office and production facilities across Oslo.

For the right candidate, there may be opportunities for more regular shifts or a permanent position over time.

Responsibilities ✔

  • Cleaning of office and production facilities.

  • Deliver high-quality service.

  • Maintain a safe and hygienic environment.

Qualifications ✔

  • Experience is a plus, but not required (training will be provided).

  • Reliable, flexible, and service-minded.

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Able to communicate in Norwegian or English.

Location 📍

Oslo

Working Hours 🕐

  • No fixed schedule or guaranteed hours.

  • You will be called in when needed.

  • Working hours may vary between weekdays, evenings, and weekends.

  • More consistent hours may occur during staff vacation periods.

Employment Type

On-demand / temporary.

Application 📩

Submit your application in Norwegian or English 17.08.2026. (The position may be filled earlier).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM is a Nordic facility management company providing tailored services to businesses and property owners. 

We work with companies that care about their brand, their people, and the environments they operate in. As a partner, not just a supplier, we deliver flexible solutions with a strong service mindset — guided by our philosophy, We Take C.A.R.E.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Business Partnership & Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Finance Business Partner to join Notion’s Strategic Finance team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, People, Legal, and other business functions to drive financial insights, improve planning processes, and provide strategic analyses to enable the company to scale thoughtfully. The ideal candidate brings deep FP&A expertise and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with executive leaders and functional leaders to drive critical business decisions. Build trusted relationships and proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities.

 - Build and own financial models, including capacity and benefits modeling. Prepare strategic trade-off analyses that help leadership prioritize investments so Notion scales responsibly.

 - Partner with Corporate Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional teams to deliver monthly and quarterly reporting and forecasting. Ensure accurate, timely reporting, providing clear variance explanations, and translating results into actionable recommendations for executives and functional leaders.

 - Identify and implement AI and automation-driven improvements that allow financial processes to scale, drive real-time reporting, and enable impactful analyses.

 - Deliver thoughtful ad hoc analyses for executive and business partner with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience leveraging AI in financial workflows. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance in the technology industry; or in accounting, investment banking, consulting, treasury, or private equity

 - Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, budget vs. actuals, annual planning, and long-range planning

 - Comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership and building cross-functional relationships

 - Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to continually up-level current approaches and processes

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with a high-growth tech company, including native AI, SaaS, or consumption-based businesses

 - Experience with NetSuite, Workday, Zip, and planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan)

 - Working knowledge of SQL



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $165,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission
